01DevTools and Productivity

Git Commands Cheat Sheet

Git ke bina aaj ka development namumkin hai — par 90% log sirf 5 commands use karte hain. Ye cheat sheet Git ke zaroori commands ko 5 groups me samjhata hai, examples ke saath, taaki tumhe kabhi Google na karna pade.

1. Git Commands Cheat Sheet — aasan bhasha me

Git aisa hai jaise ek time machine wala notebook: har baar jab tum kuch achha likhte ho, ek photo le lete ho (commit). Kuch gadbad ho to pichhli photo par wapas ja sakte ho (checkout/reset). Alag ideas ke liye alag pages (branches) use karte ho, aur aakhir me saaf pages ko main notebook me chipka dete ho (merge). Bina Git ke coding aisi hai jaise bina save ke game khelna — ek crash aur sab khatam.

Yaad rakhna: Git me teen jagah hain — Working Directory (tumhare files), Staging Area (commit ke liye chuni hui files), aur Repository (commits ka history). Har command inme se ek jagah se dusri jagah cheez le jata hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Getting started

git init — naya repo banao. git clone <url> — remote repo ki copy lao. git status — kya badla hai, kya staged hai. git config --global user.name — pehli baar apna naam/email set karo.

Clone karte hi remote origin jud jata hai. git remote -v se dekho kahan se aaya. Pehla commit karne se pehle .gitignore bana lo — node_modules aur .env kabhi commit nahi hone chahiye.

Sahi: git status har command se pehle — pata rahega kya hone wala hai.
Galat: git add . bina dekhe — secrets aur build files bhi commit ho jayenge.

Making changes

git add <file> — staging me daalo. git commit -m "msg" — snapshot banao. git diff — unstaged changes dekho. git diff --staged — staged changes dekho.

Commit message saaf likho: 'fix: login par crash' — 'changes' ya 'update' likhne se history bekar ho jati hai. Chhote commits karo — ek commit, ek kaam.

Sahi: git add -p — hunk by hunk staging, sirf wahi jo commit me chahiye.
Galat: 500 lines ka ek commit jisme feature + refactor + typo fix teeno hon.

Branching

git branch <name> — branch banao. git checkout -b <name> — banao aur switch karo. git merge <branch> — dusri branch ka kaam lao. git branch -d <name> — merge ke baad delete karo.

Branch strategy: main hamesha deployable, feature branch se kaam, PR se merge. Lambi branch mat rakho — 2 din se zyada purani branch merge conflict ka ghar hai.

Sahi: har feature ki alag branch, chhoti branch, jaldi merge.
Galat: seedha main par kaam — ek galti aur sabki main kharab.

Remote

git fetch — remote ke changes lao bina merge kiye. git pull — fetch + merge. git push — apne commits remote par bhejo. git push -u origin <branch> — pehli baar upstream set karo.

Pull karne se pehle commit kar lo ya stash kar lo — warna merge conflict. git pull --rebase se history saaf rehti hai (detail Topic 220 me).

Sahi: push se pehle pull karo — remote ke changes pehle lo, phir apne bhejo.
Galat: git push --force shared branch par — dusron ke commits ud jayenge.

Undoing

git checkout -- <file> — file ke changes wapas lo. git reset HEAD <file> — staging se hatao. git reset --soft HEAD~1 — last commit wapas, changes safe. git revert <commit> — purana commit ulta karke naya commit banao (safe, shared branch ke liye).

git reset --hard dangerous hai — changes hamesha ke liye ud jate hain. Shared branch par kabhi reset --hard + force push mat karo; revert use karo.

Sahi: shared history fix karni ho to revert — history me sab dikhta hai.
Galat: reset --hard bina soche — uncommitted kaam wapas nahi aata.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Git ke 3 areas — data kahan se kahan jata hai

Working Directory --git add--> Staging Area --git commit--> Repository
                                        ^                      |
                                        |______ git reset ______|
Repository --git push--> Remote (GitHub) --git fetch/pull--> Working Dir

Stash: beech me kaam chhupane ki jagah (git stash / git stash pop)

Roz ke kaam — command table

KaamCommand
Repo ki haalat dekhogit status
Changes dekhogit diff
Stage + commitgit add . && git commit -m "msg"
Nayi branchgit checkout -b feature/x
Remote se laogit pull --rebase
Remote par bhejogit push
History dekhogit log --oneline --graph

Neeche Git commands chalao — simulator dikhayega working directory, staging aur repo me kya hota hai. Galat command par warning bhi milegi.

  1. git status
  2. git add app.js

5. Comparison — ek table me

CommandKya karta haiSafe?
git revertUlta commit banata haiHaan, shared branch par bhi
git reset --softCommit hatata hai, changes rehte hainLocal par haan
git reset --hardCommit + changes dono udata haiKhatarnak
git push --forceRemote history overwriteShared branch par kabhi nahi

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. git add . bina status dekhe — secrets aur build files commit ho jate hain.
  2. Seedha main par kaam karna — ek galti sabki main kharab karti hai.
  3. reset --hard bina soche — uncommitted kaam wapas nahi aata.
  4. Vague commit messages ('update', 'fix') — history padhne layak nahi rehti.
  5. .gitignore bhoolna — node_modules repo me aa jata hai aur repo bhaari ho jata hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: git add, commit aur push me kya farq hai?

add file ko working directory se staging area me le jata hai; commit staging ka snapshot local repo me banata hai; push local commits ko remote (GitHub) par bhejta hai. Teenon alag steps hain — commit ke baad bhi code sirf tumhari machine par hai.

Q: git fetch aur git pull me farq?

fetch remote ke changes sirf lata hai, merge nahi karta — tum dekh sakte ho kya aaya. pull = fetch + merge — remote changes tumhari branch me mil jate hain. Review karna ho to fetch, turant kaam karna ho to pull.

Q: Galat commit ho gaya ho to kaise fix karte ho?

Local ho to reset --soft HEAD~1 karke dobara commit karo. Shared branch par ho to revert karo — purana commit hatane ki jagah uska ulta commit banao, taaki history safe rahe aur dusron ka kaam na toote.

8. Quick check

Q1. File ko commit ke liye tayyar karne ka command?

  • git commit
  • git add
  • git push

Sahi jawab: git add — git add file ko staging area me le jata hai; commit uske baad banta hai.

Q2. Shared branch par galat commit fix karne ka safe tareeka?

  • git reset --hard + force push
  • git revert
  • Branch delete kar do

Sahi jawab: git revert — Revert naya ulta commit banata hai — history safe rehti hai, dusron ka kaam nahi toot-ta.

02DevTools and Productivity

How does Git Work?

Git ka workflow samajh lo to team me kaam karna aasan ho jata hai — clone se lekar pull request tak ka safar, har step me kya hota hai aur kyun. Ye page Git workflow ko deep me samjhata hai, sirf commands nahi, poori kahani.

1. How does Git Work? — aasan bhasha me

Git workflow aisa hai jaise ek shared Google Doc par team kaam kare: sabki apni copy hoti hai (clone), har koi apne hisse par kaam karta hai (branch), phir apna kaam main doc me milane ke liye request bhejta hai (pull request), koi review karta hai, aur phir merge hota hai. Bina is system ke do log ek hi line edit karenge to ek ka kaam ud jayega — Git wahi rokta hai.

Core idea: Git distributed hai — har developer ke paas poora history hota hai. Remote (GitHub) sirf milne ki jagah hai, kaam local hota hai. Isiliye bina internet ke bhi commit kar sakte ho.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Clone & setup

git clone <url> se poora repo — history ke saath — tumhari machine par aa jata hai. Remote ka naam origin hota hai. Pehle git config user.name/user.email set karo, taaki commits par tumhara naam aaye.

Clone ke baad git branch -a se saari branches dekho, git log --oneline se history. Main branch ko kabhi seedha edit mat karo — hamesha feature branch banao.

Sahi: clone ke baad pehle README aur CONTRIBUTING padho — team ke rules wahi hote hain.
Galat: clone karke seedha main par code likhna shuru kar dena.

Branching

Har feature/fix ke liye alag branch: git checkout -b feature/login. Branch sirf ek pointer hai — ek commit par chipka hua naam. Isiliye branch banana Git me lagbhag free hai (seconds, KBs nahi).

Branch naming: feature/, fix/, hotfix/ prefix se sabko samajh aata hai branch kis liye hai. Chhoti branch rakho — 2-3 din me merge karne layak.

Sahi: ek branch = ek kaam. Do features ek branch me mat milao.
Galat: hafton purani branch — merge karte time conflict ka dher milega.

Commit

Kaam karte time chhote-chhote commits karo: git add -p se sirf relevant changes stage karo, git commit -m "feat: add login validation" se snapshot banao. Commit message me kya aur kyun likho, kaise nahi — kaise to code me dikh hi raha hai.

Conventional commits (feat:, fix:, docs:) se history padhna aur changelog banana automatic ho jata hai. git commit --amend se last commit sudhar sakte ho — par sirf local ho to.

Sahi: har commit khud me complete aur test pass karne wala ho.
Galat: 'WIP' commits ko push karna — history gandi ho jati hai.

Push & PR

git push -u origin feature/login se branch remote par jati hai. Phir GitHub par Pull Request banao: kya badla, kyun badla, kaise test kiya — ye description me likho. Reviewer code dekhta hai, comment karta hai, approve karta hai.

PR chhota rakho (200-400 lines) — bada PR koi review nahi karta, sirf approve kar deta hai. CI checks (tests, lint) green hone par hi merge karo.

Sahi: PR description me test steps likho — reviewer turant verify kar sake.
Galat: 2000 lines ka PR 'please review' likh kar bhej dena.

Merge & sync

Approve hone par merge karo — merge commit, squash, ya rebase (Topic 220 me detail). Merge ke baad apni local main update karo: git checkout main && git pull, aur purani branch delete karo.

Roz kaam shuru karne se pehle git pull --rebase se main ke naye changes apni branch me lao — warna merge ke time conflict hoga. Conflict aaye to ghabrao nahi — file me markers dikhte hain, dono versions chun kar resolve karo.

Sahi: roz rebase — branch hamesha main ke kareeb rahegi.
Galat: hafte baad pull karna — conflict resolve karne me din lag jayega.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Workflow — ek diagram ki tarah

clone → branch (feature/x) → code → add → commit
  → push → Pull Request → review → CI green
  → merge → main update → branch delete

Roz subah: git checkout main && git pull
Kaam se pehle: git checkout -b feature/x
Kaam ke baad: add → commit → push → PR

Trunk-based vs GitFlow

CheezTrunk-basedGitFlow
BranchesChhoti, 1-2 din kiFeature/develop/release/main
MergeSeedha main meDevelop → release → main
Best forCI/CD, chhoti teamScheduled releases, badi team

Aaj kal zyada teams trunk-based ya GitHub Flow (feature branch + PR) use karti hain — GitFlow sirf versioned releases (jaise mobile apps) me common hai.

4. Try karo — poora Git workflow chalao

Steps ko order me chalao — clone se PR merge tak. Galat order me chaloge to simulator rok dega.

  1. 1. git clone
  2. 2. Branch banao
  3. 3. Code + commit
  4. 4. Push + PR
  5. 5. Merge

StepCommandKahan hota hai
Clonegit cloneRemote → Local
Branchgit checkout -bLocal
Commitgit add + commitLocal
Pushgit pushLocal → Remote
PR + mergeGitHub UIRemote

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Seedha main par kaam karna — PR aur review ka fayda hi khatam.
  2. Bade PR bhejna — koi review nahi karta, sirf approve karta hai.
  3. Roz main se sync na karna — merge ke time conflict ka dher.
  4. WIP commits push karna — history gandi, revert mushkil.
  5. PR description khaali chhodna — reviewer ko samajh hi nahi aata kya review kare.

7. Interview corner

Q: Git workflow samjhao — clone se merge tak.

Clone karo, feature branch banao, chhote commits karo, push karke PR banao, review + CI ke baad merge karo, phir local main update karke branch delete karo. Roz main se rebase karke branch fresh rakho.

Q: Trunk-based aur GitFlow me kya farq hai?

Trunk-based me chhoti branches seedha main me merge hoti hain — CI/CD teams ke liye. GitFlow me develop/release/main alag branches hoti hain — scheduled versioned releases ke liye. Aaj kal zyada teams trunk-based/GitHub Flow use karti hain.

Q: Merge conflict kaise resolve karte ho?

Git file me dono versions markers ke saath dikhata hai. Sahi version chun kar (ya dono mila kar) file save karo, git add karo, aur merge/rebase continue karo. Conflict se bachne ke liye roz rebase karo aur chhoti branches rakho.

8. Quick check

Q1. Feature ka kaam kis par karna chahiye?

  • Seedha main par
  • Alag feature branch par
  • Remote par seedha

Sahi jawab: Alag feature branch par — Har feature ki alag branch — main hamesha deployable rehti hai, review bhi hota hai.

Q2. git fetch aur git pull me farq?

  • Koi farq nahi
  • fetch sirf lata hai, pull fetch + merge karta hai
  • fetch merge karta hai

Sahi jawab: fetch sirf lata hai, pull fetch + merge karta hai — fetch changes lata hai bina merge kiye; pull unhe tumhari branch me mila bhi deta hai.

03DevTools and Productivity

JSON Crack: Visualize JSON Files

JSON files itni badi aur uljhi hui hoti hain ki padhna mushkil ho jata hai — JSON Crack unhe interactive tree/graph me badal deta hai. Ye page batata hai JSON visualization kyun zaroori hai aur JSON Crack kaise kaam karta hai.

1. JSON Crack: Visualize JSON Files — aasan bhasha me

Bada JSON padhna aisa hai jaise 500 page ki kitab ko ek hi line me likha ho — sab kuch hai, par kuch samajh nahi aata. JSON Crack use kitab ko mind-map me badal deta hai: har key ek node, har value uski shaakha. Tum zoom kar sakte ho, node khol-band kar sakte ho, aur dhoond sakte ho kahan kya hai.

Yaad rakhna: JSON data ka format hai, visualization samajhne ka tareeka hai. API response, config files, logs — sab JSON me hote hain, aur bade JSON ko bina tool ke debug karna time waste hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

JSON kya hai

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) — data bhejne ka sabse common format. Key-value pairs, arrays, nested objects. APIs, config files, package.json — sab JSON hi hai. Machine ke liye perfect, insaan ke liye badi file me mushkil.

JSON ke rules sakht hain: keys double quotes me, trailing comma nahi, comments nahi. Ek comma galat ho to poora parse fail — isiliye validator chahiye hota hai.

Sahi: API response ko hamesha formatter se dekho — raw text me nested data nahi dikhta.
Galat: 2000 lines ka JSON Notepad me khol kar debug karna.

Problem

Bada JSON kyun mushkil hai? Nesting — object ke andar object ke andar array ke andar object. Size — API response MBs me ho sakta hai. Structure — kya field kahan hai, kis type ki hai, ye samajhna mushkil.

Example: ek e-commerce order JSON me user, address, items (array), har item me product, price, discounts — 6 level deep. Text me ye samajhna ghanton ka kaam hai, graph me seconds ka.

Sahi: pehle structure dekho (keys kya hain), phir values — top-down approach.
Galat: poora JSON line-by-line padhna — time waste, galti pakki.

JSON Crack

JSON Crack (jsoncrack.com) ek free open-source tool hai: JSON paste karo ya file upload karo, aur wo interactive graph bana deta hai. Nodes ko drag karo, collapse karo, search karo, aur graph ko image ke roop me download karo.

Features: JSON, YAML, CSV support; node search; dark mode; graph ko PNG/SVG me export. VS Code extension bhi hai — editor ke andar hi graph dekh sakte ho. Data browser me hi process hota hai, server par nahi jata — sensitive JSON ke liye safe.

Sahi: API debug karte time response ko JSON Crack me daalo — structure 10 second me samajh aayega.
Galat: production secrets wala JSON kisi random online formatter par paste karna — pehle check karo data kahan jata hai.

Use cases

API debugging: response ka structure samajhna. Config review: badi config me kya kya hai. Data mapping: ek system se dusre me data ja raha ho to field mapping. Documentation: graph ko image bana kar docs me daal do — text se zyada samajh aata hai.

Interview/design: data model samjhate time graph dikhana text se zyada effective hai. Team ko API contract samjhana ho to graph best hai.

Sahi: docs me JSON graph image + raw JSON dono do — dekhne wala aur copy karne wala dono khush.
Galat: sirf raw JSON docs me chipkana — koi nahi padhega.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

JSON ka example — text vs graph

{
  "order": {
    "id": 4821,
    "user": { "name": "Asha", "city": "Pune" },
    "items": [
      { "name": "Book", "price": 499 },
      { "name": "Pen", "price": 49 }
    ]
  }
}

Text me: 6 level ki nesting dhoondhni padti hai.
Graph me: order → user/items → har item — ek nazar me.

ToolKaamKhaas baat

jqCommand line queryTerminal me JSON filter karo
PostmanAPI test + pretty viewResponse tree view
VS CodeFormat + foldBuilt-in, extension bhi

4. Try karo — JSON ko graph me badlo

Neeche ek sample JSON hai — buttons se use graph ki tarah explore karo. Har button ek node kholta hai.

  1. order node kholo
  2. user node kholo
  3. items array kholo
  4. "price" search karo

TareekaBade JSON ke liyeSpeed
Raw textMushkilSlow
Formatter (Prettier)TheekMedium
JSON Crack graphBestFast

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Bada JSON raw text me padhna — structure samajh hi nahi aata.
  2. Secrets wala JSON random online tool par paste karna — data leak ho sakta hai.
  3. JSON me trailing comma ya comments — parse fail hoga, JSON ke rules sakht hain.
  4. API docs me sirf raw JSON dena — graph ya table bhi do.
  5. jq jaise tools na seekhna — terminal me JSON debug karna mushkil rehta hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: JSON Crack kya karta hai aur kyun useful hai?

JSON ko interactive graph/tree me badal deta hai — har key ek node, nesting visually dikhti hai. Bade API responses ya config files ka structure seconds me samajh aata hai, jo raw text me ghante lagte. Search, collapse aur export bhi karta hai.

Q: JSON aur YAML me farq?

JSON sakht hai — double quotes, no comments, no trailing comma; machine-to-machine ke liye best. YAML insaan ke liye readable hai — comments allowed, indentation based; config files ke liye popular. Dono ek dusre me convert ho sakte hain.

Q: Bade JSON ko terminal me kaise debug karte ho?

jq se — jaise jq '.items[0].price' se seedha field nikalo, ya jq 'keys' se structure dekho. Bina tool ke grep karna bekar hai kyunki JSON ek line me bhi ho sakta hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. JSON Crack ka main kaam kya hai?

  • JSON ko compress karna
  • JSON ko interactive graph me dikhana
  • JSON ko database me dalna

Sahi jawab: JSON ko interactive graph me dikhana — Graph visualization — nesting aur structure ek nazar me samajh aati hai.

Q2. JSON me kya allowed nahi hai?

  • Nested objects
  • Trailing comma aur comments
  • Arrays

Sahi jawab: Trailing comma aur comments — JSON ke rules sakht hain — trailing comma ya comment se parse fail ho jata hai.

04DevTools and Productivity

Git vs GitHub

Git vs GitHub — sabse common confusion. Git ek tool hai, GitHub ek website/service hai. Git bina GitHub ke chalta hai, GitHub bina Git ke nahi. Ye page dono ka farq saaf karta hai, ek table me aur examples ke saath.

1. Git vs GitHub — aasan bhasha me

Git aisa hai jaise Word processor (MS Word) aur GitHub aisa hai jaise Google Docs — Word se tum document likhte ho, track changes karte ho, offline kaam karte ho. Google Docs wo jagah hai jahan document share hota hai, log comment karte hain, aur sab mil kar edit karte hain. Word bina Google Docs ke chalta hai; Google Docs ka fayda tabhi jab document Word (ya kisi editor) se bana ho. Git = tool, GitHub = sharing + collaboration platform.

Yaad rakhna: interview me ye sawal isiliye poochhte hain — kyunki bahut log dono ko ek samajhte hain. Ek line me jawab: Git version control system hai, GitHub us par bani hosting + collaboration service hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Git kya hai

Git ek distributed version control system hai — Linus Torvalds ne 2005 me Linux kernel ke liye banaya tha. Ye tumhari machine par chalta hai: commits, branches, merges — sab local. Internet ki zaroorat nahi.

Git ka kaam: har change ka snapshot rakhna, history dena, branches se parallel kaam karwana, aur merge karna. Git free aur open source hai. Git ke alternatives: Mercurial, SVN (centralized).

Sahi: Git seekhna matlab version control seekhna — GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket sab isi par hain.
Galat: ye sochna ki Git sirf GitHub ke saath chalta hai — Git local bhi poora kaam karta hai.

GitHub kya hai

GitHub ek cloud hosting + collaboration platform hai jo Git repositories ko host karta hai. Microsoft ki company hai. Is par milta hai: remote repo hosting, Pull Requests, Issues, Actions (CI/CD), Projects, aur duniya bhar ke developers ka network.

GitHub bina Git ke kaam nahi karta — andar se wo bhi Git hi use karta hai. Alternatives: GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea (self-hosted).

Sahi: GitHub ko collaboration layer samjho — review, CI, issues, teams.
Galat: GitHub par code daal kar sochna 'backup ho gaya' — private repo aur access bhi check karo.

Farq

Git: tool, local, command line, free, offline chalta hai. GitHub: service, cloud, web UI + API, free/paid plans, internet chahiye.

Example: tum git commit karte ho — ye Git hai, offline. git push karke GitHub par bhejte ho, PR banate ho — ye GitHub hai. PR review, merge, CI — sab GitHub ki features hain, Git ki nahi.

Sahi: dono ka farq ek line me bol sako — interview me yahi poochhte hain.
Galat: 'GitHub se clone kiya' ko 'Git use kiya' se confuse karna — clone Git ka command hai, GitHub sirf URL deta hai.

Saath me

Dono saath me kaise kaam karte hain: local par Git (branch, commit), remote par GitHub (host, PR, review, CI). Workflow: clone (GitHub se) → branch/commit (Git) → push (GitHub par) → PR (GitHub) → merge (GitHub) → pull (Git).

GitHub Actions se CI/CD bhi chalta hai — push hote hi tests chalte hain. Ye sab GitHub ki layer hai; Git ko isse koi matlab nahi.

Sahi: Git seekho pehle, GitHub baad me — Git aata hai to GitLab/Bitbucket bhi aasan lagenge.
Galat: sirf GitHub web UI se kaam karna — CLI aaye bina real workflow nahi aayega.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Git vs GitHub — ek table me

CheezGitGitHub
Kya haiVersion control toolHosting + collaboration platform
Kahan chalta haiTumhari machine (local)Cloud (github.com)
InternetNahi chahiyeChahiye
BanayaLinus Torvalds (2005)GitHub Inc (2008), ab Microsoft
KaamCommit, branch, mergePR, Issues, Actions, hosting
AlternativesMercurial, SVNGitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea

Kaunsa command kiska hai?

Git ke commands (local):
  git init, git add, git commit, git branch, git merge, git log

GitHub se judde (remote):
  git clone, git fetch, git pull, git push  (remote = GitHub/GitLab...)
  PR, review, Actions, Issues → sirf GitHub website par

4. Try karo — pehchano: ye Git hai ya GitHub?

Neeche ek kaam diya jayega — batao wo Git ka kaam hai ya GitHub ka. Simulator turant batayega sahi ya galat aur kyun.

  1. git commit karna
  2. Pull Request banana
  3. Branch banana
  4. Push par tests chalana (CI)

5. Comparison — ek table me

KaamGit ya GitHub?
Commit bananaGit
Branch bananaGit
Merge karna (local)Git
Pull RequestGitHub
Code review commentsGitHub
CI/CD (Actions)GitHub
Issues / ProjectsGitHub

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Git aur GitHub ko ek samajhna — interview me ye galti pakki fail karwati hai.
  2. Sirf GitHub UI use karna aur CLI na seekhna — real workflow CLI par hai.
  3. Ye sochna ki GitHub ke bina Git bekar hai — Git offline poora kaam karta hai.
  4. PR ko Git ka feature samajhna — PR hosting platform ki feature hai.
  5. GitLab/Bitbucket ko alag samajhna — andar se sab Git hi hain.

7. Interview corner

Q: Git aur GitHub me kya farq hai?

Git ek distributed version control tool hai jo local machine par chalta hai — commit, branch, merge. GitHub ek cloud platform hai jo Git repos ko host karta hai aur collaboration deta hai — Pull Requests, Issues, Actions. Git bina GitHub ke chalta hai, GitHub bina Git ke nahi.

Q: Git ke bina GitHub use kar sakte ho?

Web UI se chhote edits kar sakte ho, par asli kaam — branch, commit, merge, history — Git se hi hota hai. GitHub andar se bhi Git hi use karta hai. Isiliye pehle Git seekho.

Q: GitHub ke alternatives kaunse hain?

GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, Codeberg. Sab Git par based hain — Git aata hai to kisi par bhi kaam kar sakte ho, sirf UI aur features ka farq hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Pull Request kiski feature hai?

  • Git
  • GitHub
  • Dono

Sahi jawab: GitHub — Git me PR ka concept hi nahi — ye GitHub/GitLab jaise hosting platforms ki feature hai.

Q2. Bina internet ke kya kar sakte ho?

  • git commit aur branch
  • Pull Request banana
  • GitHub Actions chalana

Sahi jawab: git commit aur branch — Git local hai — commit, branch, merge sab offline chalte hain. GitHub ke liye internet chahiye.

Guide ke khaas points — key differences (original se)

  • Git free, open-source version control tool hai; GitHub cloud-based, pay-for-use service hai jo Git ko cloud me chalata hai.
  • Git developer ki local machine par install hota hai; GitHub cloud me hosted hota hai.
  • Git ko Linux Foundation maintain karta hai; GitHub ko Microsoft own karta hai.
  • Git files ke alag-alag versions manage karta hai; GitHub code host karne, collaborate karne aur project manage karne ki jagah hai.
  • Git me minimal external tool configuration hoti hai; GitHub par tool integration ke liye active marketplace milta hai.
  • Aakhiri baat yaad rakhna: Git ke bina GitHub nahi chal sakta, par GitHub ke bina Git chal sakta hai — Git ko GitHub ki zaroorat nahi hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/git-vs-github.md
← PichhlaJSON Crack: Visualize JSON FilesAgla →Git Merge vs. Git Rebase
05DevTools and Productivity

Git Merge vs. Git Rebase

Git merge aur git rebase dono branches ko milate hain — par history alag banti hai. Merge history sachchi rakhta hai, rebase history saaf rakhta hai. Kab kya use karein, aur rebase ka golden rule kya hai — ye page sab kholta hai.

1. Git Merge vs. Git Rebase — aasan bhasha me

Merge aisa hai jaise do alag notebooks ke pages ko ek file me staple kar do — dono ki history dikhti hai, aur ek extra page (merge commit) batata hai kab milaya. Rebase aisa hai jaise ek notebook ke pages ko dusre ke baad dobara likh do — ek seedhi line banti hai, jaise sab kuch ek hi baar me likha gaya ho. Staple karna sachcha hai, dobara likhna saaf hai — dono ke apne fayde aur khatre hain.

Golden rule: jo branch dusron ne bhi use ki hai (shared — jaise main), use kabhi rebase mat karo. Rebase sirf apni private branch par karo.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Git merge

git merge feature — dusri branch ke commits ko apni branch me milata hai aur ek merge commit banata hai. History me dikhta hai kab, kisne, kya milaya — poori sachchai.

Faayda: safe, history kabhi rewrite nahi hoti, shared branch ke liye best. Nuksaan: history me bahut saare merge commits — graph uljha hua dikhta hai, git log padhna mushkil.

Sahi: main me feature merge karna, shared branch update karna — hamesha merge.
Galat: har chhote update par merge commit — history merge commits se bhar jati hai.

Git rebase

git rebase main — apne commits ko uthakar main ke latest commit ke upar rakh deta hai. Jaise tumne kaam abhi-abhi main ke upar kiya ho. History ek seedhi line ban jati hai, koi merge commit nahi.

Faayda: saaf history, git log padhna aasan, bisect se bug dhoondna aasan. Nuksaan: commits rewrite hote hain (naye hash) — isiliye shared branch par khatarnak.

Sahi: apni feature branch ko main ke upar rebase karna, PR se pehle history saaf karna.
Galat: main ko rebase karna ya pushed commits ko rebase karke force push karna.

Golden rule

Never rebase a shared branch. Rebase commit ke hash badal deta hai — agar dusron ne purane commits par kaam kiya hai, unka kaam toot jayega. Isiliye: rebase sirf local/private branch par, merge shared branch par.

Galti se rebase kar diya ho to git reflog se purani state wapas mil sakti hai — reflog Git ka safety net hai, har move record karta hai.

Sahi: PR se pehle apni branch par rebase + squash — reviewer ko saaf history milegi.
Galat: team ki main branch ko rebase karke force push — sabka kaam tootega.

Kab kya

Merge karo: feature ko main me milate time, shared branch update karte time, jab history ki sachchai chahiye. Rebase karo: apni branch ko main ke upar fresh karte time, PR se pehle history saaf karte time, chhote fixup commits ko milate time (interactive rebase).

Teams aksar ye rule rakhti hain: feature branch par rebase allowed, main par sirf merge (ya squash merge). Squash merge PR ke saare commits ko ek commit bana deta hai — main ki history ekdum saaf rehti hai.

Sahi: team ka rule likh lo — kaun kab merge karega, kaun rebase.
Galat: har developer apni marzi se merge/rebase kare — history ka koi pattern nahi rahega.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Merge vs Rebase — history kaisi dikhti hai

MERGE (history sachchi, graph uljha):
  *   Merge branch 'feature' into main
  |\ 
  | * C3 (feature ka kaam)
  | * C2
  * | C1 (main ka kaam)
  |/
  * C0

REBASE (history seedhi, saaf):
  * C3' (feature ka kaam, main ke upar)
  * C2'
  * C1 (main ka kaam)
  * C0

C2' aur C3' naye commits hain — hash badal gaye!

Interactive rebase — history sudharo

git rebase -i HEAD~3
# pick, squash, fixup, reword — commits ko
# milao, naam badlo, ya order badlo.
# PR se pehle 5 'WIP' commits ko 1 saaf commit banao.

4. Try karo — merge vs rebase, history dekho

Dono tareeke try karo aur dekho history kaisi banti hai. Phir shared branch par rebase karke dekho kya hota hai.

  1. git merge feature
  2. git rebase main
  3. Shared branch par rebase (galti!)

5. Comparison — ek table me

CheezMergeRebase
HistorySachchi, branch dikhti haiSeedhi, saaf
Merge commitBanta haiNahi banta
Commits rewriteNahiHaan (naye hash)
Shared branchSafeKhatarnak
Best formain me mergeApni branch fresh karna

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Shared branch (main) ko rebase karna — team ka kaam toot jata hai.
  2. Rebase ke baad bina soche force push — dusron ke commits ud sakte hain.
  3. Har chhote update par merge commit banana — history gandi.
  4. Interactive rebase se darna — WIP commits ko squash karna hi uska kaam hai.
  5. Rebase ke time conflict se ghabrana — resolve karo, git rebase --continue karo.

7. Interview corner

Q: Merge aur rebase me kya farq hai?

Merge dusri branch ko mila kar ek merge commit banata hai — history sachchi rehti hai, graph me branch dikhti hai. Rebase tumhare commits ko dusri branch ke upar dobara likhta hai — history seedhi aur saaf banti hai, par commit hash badal jate hain.

Q: Rebase ka golden rule kya hai?

Shared branch ko kabhi rebase mat karo. Rebase sirf apni private/local branch par karo. Shared branch par rebase karne se dusron ke local copy se mismatch ho jata hai aur unka kaam toot-ta hai.

Q: PR merge karte time squash merge kyun use karte hain?

Taaki main ki history saaf rahe — PR ke 10 chhote commits (WIP, typo fix) ek saaf commit ban jate hain. Main par har commit ek complete feature hota hai, history padhna aur revert karna aasan hota hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Shared branch (main) par kya karna chahiye?

  • Rebase
  • Merge
  • Force push

Sahi jawab: Merge — Shared branch par hamesha merge — rebase hash badal deta hai aur team ka kaam toot-ta hai.

Q2. Rebase se history kaisi banti hai?

  • Uljhi hui, merge commits ke saath
  • Seedhi line, bina merge commit
  • History delete ho jati hai

Sahi jawab: Seedhi line, bina merge commit — Rebase commits ko upar dobara likhta hai — seedhi, saaf history banti hai.

Guide ke khaas points — merge vs rebase (original se)

  • Git Merge: main branch me ek naya commit G' banta hai jo main aur feature dono branches ki history ko jod deta hai. Merge non-destructive hai — na main branch badalti hai, na feature branch.
  • Git Rebase: feature branch ki history ko main branch ke head par move kar deta hai — har commit ke liye naye commits E', F', G' bante hain. Fayda: linear commit history milti hai, seedhi line me.
  • The Golden Rule of Git Rebase: kabhi bhi rebase ko public branches par use mat karo! Public branch par rebase karna dusron ki history bigaad deta hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/git-merge-vs-git-rebate.md

06DevTools and Productivity

30 Useful AI Apps That Can Help You in 2025

2025 me AI apps har kaam me ghus gaye hain — code likhna, design karna, likhna, seekhna, audience banana. Ye page 30 useful AI apps ko 6 groups me samjhata hai, taaki tumhe pata ho kaunsa tool kis kaam ke liye hai.

1. 30 Useful AI Apps That Can Help You in 2025 — aasan bhasha me

AI apps aise hain jaise ek bade office me alag-alag departments: ek likhne wala (writing), ek code karne wala (coding), ek design karne wala, ek teacher (learning), ek manager (productivity), aur ek artist (creativity). Har department ka apna best tool hai — tumhe sirf ye pata hona chahiye kaunsa kaam kis department ko dena hai. Galat department ko kaam doge to result kharab aayega.

Yaad rakhna: AI tool tumhari jagah nahi leta — wo tumhari speed 10x karta hai. Jo tool tumhare daily kaam me 30 minute bachata hai, wahi best tool hai — list me sabse famous wala nahi.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

General purpose

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity — general AI assistants. Sawal poochho, draft likhwao, samjhwao, summarize karwao. ChatGPT sabse versatile, Claude lambi writing aur code me strong, Gemini Google ecosystem me, Perplexity search + sources ke saath jawab deta hai.

Use: research, brainstorming, email draft, kisi topic ko aasan bhasha me samajhna. Hamesha fact-check karo — AI confidently galat bhi bol sakta hai.

Sahi: Perplexity se sources ke saath research, Claude se lamba document draft.
Galat: AI ka jawab bina check kiye copy-paste karna — galat fact pakka milega.

Writing code

GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, Tabnine — code likhte time suggestion dete hain, poora function likh dete hain, bug dhoondte hain. Copilot sabse zyada use hota hai, Cursor AI-first editor hai jisme chat se poora feature banta hai.

Use: boilerplate, tests likhna, purana code samajhna, debugging. Code review ke liye bhi use karo — AI se poochho 'is code me bug kahan hai?'

Sahi: Copilot se boilerplate, khud se logic — control tumhare haath me rahe.
Galat: AI ka code bina padhe commit karna — security bug bhi aa sakta hai.

Productivity

Notion AI, Otter.ai, Fireflies, Grammarly — notes, meetings, writing. Otter/Fireflies meeting ko transcribe karke summary banate hain — meeting ke baad notes likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Notion AI docs aur tasks manage karta hai, Grammarly likhai sudharta hai.

Use: meeting notes, email, documentation, task planning. Roz ke 30-60 minute bachate hain.

Sahi: har meeting par Otter/Fireflies — action items automatic milte hain.
Galat: sensitive meeting ko bina permission ke record karna — privacy ka dhyaan rakho.

Audience building

Opus Clip, Descript, Buffer AI, Hootsuite AI — content creators ke liye. Opus Clip lambi video se viral short clips banata hai, Descript se video ko text ki tarah edit karo, Buffer/Hootsuite post schedule aur caption likhte hain.

Use: YouTube/Instagram content, newsletter, social media. Ek video se 10 shorts — content ka reuse hi growth hai.

Sahi: ek long video → Opus se clips → Buffer se schedule — poora pipeline.
Galat: sirf AI captions par bharosa — apni awaaz kho jayegi.

Creativity

Midjourney, DALL-E, Runway, Leonardo — images aur video. Midjourney artistic images ke liye best, DALL-E ChatGPT ke andar, Runway video generate/edit karta hai. Leonardo game assets aur design ke liye.

Use: thumbnails, presentations, mockups, social posts. Copyright ka dhyaan rakho — commercial use ke terms padh lo.

Sahi: thumbnail aur mockup ke liye — tez aur sasta.
Galat: AI image ko asli photo bol kar use karna — misleading hai.

Learning

Duolingo Max, Khanmigo, NotebookLM, Socratic — seekhne ke liye. NotebookLM tumhare documents se podcast aur quiz banata hai — apne notes se seekhna ab aasan hai. Khanmigo tutor ki tarah sawaal-jawaab karta hai.

Use: nayi language, exam prep, kisi bade document ko samajhna. NotebookLM se apne PDF ka audio overview banao aur chalte-firte suno.

Sahi: NotebookLM me apne notes daalo — AI tumhare material se hi sikhayega.
Galat: AI se seedha homework karwana — seekhoge nahi, exam me fail hoge.

AI tool chunne ka rule

Tool tabhi rakho jab wo hafte me kam se kam 3 baar kaam aaye. Har naya tool seekhne me time lagta hai — 30 tools install karke 3 bhi use na karna waste hai. Pehle apna sabse bada time-waste wala kaam pehchano, phir uska ek tool chuno.

4. Try karo — apna kaam batao, tool pao

Apna kaam chuno — simulator batayega kaunsa AI tool best hai aur use kaise karna hai.

  1. Code likhna hai
  2. Meeting notes chahiye

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. 30 tools install karke 3 bhi use na karna — ek kaam, ek tool.
  2. AI ka jawab bina fact-check kiye use karna — galat facts aam hain.
  3. Sensitive data (passwords, private docs) AI tools par daalna — privacy policy padho.
  4. AI se homework/code poora karwana — seekhna band, skill nahi banti.
  5. Har kaam ke liye naya tool dhoondhna — pehle jo hai use achhe se seekho.

7. Interview corner

Q: AI coding tools ko effectively kaise use karte ho?

Boilerplate, tests aur debugging ke liye — logic aur architecture khud decide karta hoon. Prompt me context deta hoon (language, framework, constraints) aur AI ka code padh kar hi commit karta hoon. AI pair programmer hai, replacement nahi.

Q: AI tools chunne ka tumhara criteria kya hai?

Pehle time-waste wala kaam pehchano, phir uska tool chuno. Tool hafte me 3+ baar kaam aaye tabhi rakho. Free plan se shuru karo, value dikhe to paid lo. Privacy bhi dekho — sensitive data kahan jata hai.

Q: AI ke jawab par bharosa kaise karte ho?

Fact-check karo — khaas taur par numbers, dates aur code. Perplexity jaise tools sources dete hain, unhe kholo. Code ko chalakar dekho. AI confidently galat bol sakta hai, isiliye verification part of workflow hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Meeting ke notes aur action items ke liye best tool kaunsa hai?

  • Midjourney
  • Otter.ai / Fireflies
  • DALL-E

Sahi jawab: Otter.ai / Fireflies — Otter/Fireflies meeting transcribe karke summary aur action items banate hain.

Q2. Bada PDF samajhna ho to kaunsa tool best hai?

  • Opus Clip
  • NotebookLM
  • Buffer

← PichhlaGit Merge vs. Git RebaseAgla →Diagram as Code
07DevTools and Productivity

Diagram as Code

Diagram as Code matlab diagrams ko bhi code ki tarah likhna — text file se diagram banta hai, version control me rehta hai, aur review hota hai. Drag-drop tools se 10x behtar, khaas taur par system design diagrams ke liye.

1. Diagram as Code — aasan bhasha me

Diagram as Code aisa hai jaise khana recipe se banana vs andaze se banana: drag-drop tool me har baar diagram haath se banta hai — ek box idhar, ek line udhar. Code me diagram likho to recipe ban jati hai — koi bhi use chala kar wahi diagram bana sakta hai, badlav ek line ka hai, aur purani recipe Git me safe hai. Team me diagram share karna recipe share karne jaisa ho jata hai.

Yaad rakhna: diagrams docs ka hissa hain — aur docs ka version control hona chahiye. Diagram as Code se diagram bhi PR me review hota hai, jaise code hota hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Kya hai

Diagram as Code (DaC) — diagrams ko text/code se define karo, tool use render kare. Example: Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz. Tum likhte ho text, tool banata hai diagram — PNG/SVG.

Faayda: Git me versioning, PR me review, diff dikhta hai, aur koi bhi text edit karke diagram badal sakta hai. Drag-drop tools me diagram binary file hoti hai — diff nahi dikhta, merge nahi hota.

Sahi: architecture docs, README, design docs — sab me DaC diagrams.
Galat: har chhote rough sketch ke liye DaC — whiteboard sketch ke liye pen-paper hi best hai.

Mermaid

Mermaid — sabse popular, Markdown me seedha chalta hai. GitHub README me Mermaid code likho, GitHub khud render kar deta hai. Flowchart, sequence diagram, class diagram, ER diagram — sab support karta hai.

Syntax simple hai: A --> B matlab A se B tak arrow. Notion, Obsidian, GitLab bhi support karte hain. Seekhne me 10 minute lagte hain.

Sahi: README aur docs me Mermaid — koi extra tool nahi chahiye.
Galat: bahut complex diagram Mermaid me — layout control kam hai, bade diagram messy ho jate hain.

PlantUML

PlantUML — UML diagrams (sequence, class, use-case) ke liye best. Text se UML banta hai, Java-based hai, aur bahut saare tools me integrated hai (IntelliJ, VS Code, Confluence).

Sequence diagrams ke liye PlantUML sabse achha hai — participants aur messages text me likho, diagram ban jata hai. C4 model ke diagrams bhi PlantUML se bante hain.

Sahi: sequence aur class diagrams, C4 architecture diagrams.
Galat: PlantUML ke liye Java/server chahiye — setup Mermaid se zyada hai.

Aur tools

Graphviz (DOT) — purana aur powerful, graph layout algorithms ke liye best. D2 — modern, Mermaid jaisa par zyada control. Structurizr — C4 model ke liye, code se architecture diagrams. Excalidraw — hand-drawn style, rough sketches ke liye (code nahi, par export JSON hota hai).

Tool chunne ka rule: docs me hai to Mermaid, UML chahiye to PlantUML, complex graph ho to Graphviz/D2.

Sahi: ek tool team me standard rakho — sab wahi use karen.
Galat: har diagram ke liye alag tool — team confuse ho jayegi.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Mermaid example — flowchart

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[User] --> B[API Gateway]
    B --> C[Order Service]
    B --> D[Payment Service]
    C --> E[(Database)]
```
GitHub is code ko khud diagram bana dega.

Sequence diagram — PlantUML

@startuml
User -> Gateway: POST /orders
Gateway -> OrderService: createOrder()
OrderService -> PaymentService: charge()
PaymentService --> OrderService: OK
OrderService --> User: 201 Created
@enduml

DaC vs drag-drop

CheezDiagram as CodeDrag-drop (Draw.io)
Version controlGit diff dikhta haiBinary, diff nahi
ReviewPR me hota haiFile share karni padti hai
BadlavEk line editHaath se move karo
Layout controlKamPoora

4. Try karo — Mermaid code se diagram banao

Neeche Mermaid code ke tukde chalao — simulator dikhayega har line se diagram me kya banta hai.

  1. Flowchart banao
  2. Sequence banao
  3. Ek line badlo, diagram update

5. Comparison — ek table me

ToolBest forSeekhne me
MermaidDocs, README, flowchart10 min
PlantUMLUML, sequence, C430 min
GraphvizComplex graphs1 ghanta
D2Modern diagrams20 min
Draw.ioPixel-perfect layoutDrag-drop

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Diagrams ko binary files me rakhna — Git diff aur review dono khatam.
  2. Har diagram ke liye alag tool — team me standard rakho.
  3. Diagram ko docs se alag rakhna — diagram purana ho jata hai, code naya.
  4. Bahut complex diagram ek Mermaid file me — tod kar chhote diagrams banao.
  5. Diagram bana kar kabhi update na karna — galat diagram sahi se zyada khatarnak hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: Diagram as Code kya hai aur kyun use karte ho?

Diagrams ko text/code se define karna — jaise Mermaid ya PlantUML. Faayda: Git me versioning, PR me review, diff dikhta hai, aur badlav ek line ka hota hai. Drag-drop tools me diagram binary hota hai — na diff, na review.

Q: Mermaid aur PlantUML me kya farq hai?

Mermaid simple hai, Markdown/GitHub me seedha chalta hai — flowchart aur basic diagrams ke liye best. PlantUML UML diagrams (sequence, class) aur C4 ke liye zyada powerful hai, par setup zyada chahiye.

Q: Architecture diagrams ko updated kaise rakhte ho?

Diagrams ko code ke saath repo me rakho (DaC), design doc ke hisse ke roop me. PR me diagram bhi review ho. Aur bade systems ke liye Structurizr jaise tools se code se diagram generate karo — diagram kabhi stale nahi hota.

8. Quick check

Q1. Diagram as Code ka sabse bada fayda kya hai?

  • Diagram sundar banta hai
  • Git me versioning aur PR review hota hai
  • Koi tool nahi chahiye

Sahi jawab: Git me versioning aur PR review hota hai — Text-based diagram Git diff aur PR review me aata hai — drag-drop binary me ye possible nahi.

Q2. GitHub README me seedha render hone wala tool kaunsa hai?

  • PlantUML
  • Mermaid
  • Graphviz

Sahi jawab: Mermaid — Mermaid GitHub Markdown me native support karta hai — code likho, diagram khud ban jata hai.

Guide ke khaas points — Diagram as Code kya hai (original se)

Diagram as Code ka matlab hai: jo code hum likhte hain, wo automatically architecture diagram me badal jaye. Iske liye ek GitHub repo hai jo cloud system architecture ko Python code se draw karta hai.

  • Cloud system architecture ko Python code me likho — diagram apne aap ban jata hai.
  • Diagrams ko seedha Jupyter Notebooks ke andar bhi render kar sakte ho.
  • Koi design tool kholne ki zaroorat nahi — code hi diagram hai.
  • Supported providers: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Alibaba Cloud, Oracle Cloud aur bhi.
  • Prototyping ke liye best hai — architecture badlo to code badlo, diagram khud update ho jata hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/diagram-as-code.md
← Pichhla30 Useful AI Apps That Can Help You in 2025Agla →Top 9 Causes of 100% CPU Usage
08DevTools and Productivity

Top 9 Causes of 100% CPU Usage

CPU 100% par hai aur system crawl kar raha hai — kyun? 9 common kaaran hain, aur har kaaran ka alag fix hai. Ye page har kaaran ko samjhata hai, diagnose karne ka tareeka aur solution ke saath.

1. Top 9 Causes of 100% CPU Usage — aasan bhasha me

CPU 100% hona aisa hai jaise ek cook par 100 order aa jayein: ho sakta hai cook slow ho (inefficient code), ya order hi galat likhe hon (infinite loop), ya bahut saare log ek hi cook ko bula rahe hon (too many threads), ya cook ko baar-baar bazaar bheja ja raha ho (context switching). Cook ko daantne se pehle ye samajhna padta hai ki order kyun atak rahe hain — warna cook badalne par bhi wahi hoga.

Pehla step hamesha: top ya Task Manager se dekho — kaunsi process CPU kha rahi hai? User CPU zyada hai (tumhara code) ya system CPU (kernel)? Bina ye jaane fix karna andhere me teer hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Infinite loop

Sabse common kaaran: infinite loop — loop ki condition kabhi false nahi hoti. Ek thread 100% CPU kha jata hai, baaki sab ruk jate hain. JavaScript me ek infinite loop poora page freeze kar deta hai.

Diagnose: CPU ek core par 100%, baaki idle — ek thread phasa hai. Stack trace (jstack, py-spy) se dekho kaunsi line par loop ghoom raha hai. Fix: loop condition aur exit condition check karo, timeout lagao.

Sahi: loop me hamesha progress guarantee + max iterations ya timeout.
Galat: while(true) bina break ke — kabhi bharosa mat karo ki condition khud badlegi.

Inefficient code

Inefficient algorithms — O(n²) loop jahan O(n) kaafi tha, ya har request par poora data scan. Data badhte hi CPU 100% ho jata hai. N+1 queries bhi isi category me aati hain.

Diagnose: profiler chalao (perf, async-profiler, py-spy) — kaunsa function sabse zyada time le raha hai, ye dikh jayega. Fix: algorithm badlo, caching lagao, batching karo.

Sahi: pehle profile karo, phir optimize — andaze se optimize karna time waste hai.
Galat: 'code optimize karo' bol kar har jagah micro-optimization — asli bottleneck kahin aur hota hai.

Too many threads

Zyada threads — 1000 threads ek CPU par, har thread thoda kaam karta hai, baaki time context switch me jata hai. Context switching mehenga hai — CPU kaam karne ki jagah threads badalne me lag jata hai.

Fix: thread pool ka size CPU cores ke hisaab se rakho (CPU-bound: cores+1, I/O-bound: zyada). Async/non-blocking I/O use karo taaki thread block na ho.

Sahi: thread pool size = cores ke hisaab se, queue se overflow sambhalo.
Galat: har request par naya thread banana — 10k requests = 10k threads = crash.

GC pressure

Garbage collection — bahut zyada objects bante hain to GC baar-baar chalta hai aur CPU kha jata hai. Java/Go me GC pause aur CPU dono dikhte hain. Short-lived objects ki baarish ho to GC kabhi rukta hi nahi.

Diagnose: GC logs dekho — kitni baar GC chala, kitna time liya. Fix: object reuse karo, allocation kam karo, heap size sahi rakho (zyada heap = lamba GC pause).

Sahi: GC logs on rakho, allocation rate monitor karo.
Galat: heap badha kar GC problem chhupana — pause aur bada ho jayega.

I/O wait?

Note: I/O wait CPU 100% nahi dikhata — wo to CPU idle dikhata hai jabki system slow hai. Par excessive I/O (disk read/write ki baarish) system CPU badhata hai — har I/O par kernel kaam karta hai.

Aur bhi kaaran: lock contention (threads ek lock ke liye ladte hain), regex catastrophic backtracking, busy waiting (sleep ke bina poll karna), aur malware/mining (kisi ne tumhare server par miner chala diya).

Sahi: top me %us (user) vs %sy (system) dekho — user zyada hai to tumhara code, system zyada hai to kernel/I/O.
Galat: CPU 100% dekh kar turant server bada karna — pehle kaaran dhoondho.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

9 kaaran — ek table me

#KaaranPehchanFix
1Infinite loopEk core 100%Loop condition + timeout
2Inefficient codeProfiler me hot functionAlgorithm/cache
3Too many threadsContext switches zyadaThread pool size
4GC pressureGC logs me baar-baar GCAllocation kam karo
5Lock contentionThreads blocked dikhte hainLock granularity kam karo
6Excessive I/OSystem CPU zyadaBatching, buffering
7Regex backtrackingEk request par CPU spikeRegex simplify karo
8Busy waitingSleep ke bina pollingSleep ya event-driven
9Malware/miningAnjaan process CPU kha rahaProcess maaro, server scan karo

Diagnose karne ke commands

top / htop        — kaunsi process kitna CPU kha rahi hai
perf top          — kaunsa function CPU kha raha hai
py-spy / jstack   — Python/Java thread kahan atka hai
vmstat 1          — user vs system CPU, context switches
gc logs           — GC kitni baar, kitni der

4. Try karo — CPU 100% diagnose karo

Neeche ek scenario chalao — simulator batayega CPU kyun 100% hai aur fix kya hai.

  1. Ek core 100%, baaki idle
  2. 1000 threads, sab busy
  3. GC baar-baar chal raha
  4. Anjaan process CPU kha raha

5. Comparison — ek table me

SymptomKaaranTool
Ek core 100%Infinite loopjstack / py-spy
Saare cores 100%Heavy computationprofiler
Context switches zyadaToo many threadsvmstat
GC baar-baarAllocation zyadaGC logs
System CPU zyadaExcessive I/Oiotop

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. CPU 100% dekh kar turant server bada karna — kaaran dhoondho pehle.
  2. Profiler chalaye bina optimize karna — andaze se bottleneck nahi milta.
  3. Har request par naya thread banana — thread pool use karo.
  4. GC problem ko heap badha kar chhupana — pause aur badega.
  5. Anjaan process ko ignore karna — miner ya malware ho sakta hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: CPU 100% ho to kaise diagnose karte ho?

Pehle top se dekho kaunsi process aur user vs system CPU. Ek core 100% ho to thread dump (jstack/py-spy) — infinite loop ya stuck thread. Saare cores 100% hon to profiler — kaunsa function time le raha hai. Context switches zyada hon to thread count dekho, GC baar-baar ho to GC logs.

Q: Context switching kyun mehenga hai?

Har switch par CPU ko registers, stack aur cache state save/load karni padti hai, aur cache thanda ho jata hai. 1000 threads par CPU kaam se zyada switch me lag jata hai — isiliye thread pool size cores ke hisaab se rakhte hain.

Q: GC pressure se CPU kaise badhta hai?

Bahut zyada short-lived objects bante hain to GC baar-baar chalta hai — har GC cycle CPU khata hai aur application rukti hai. Fix: allocation kam karo, objects reuse karo, heap size sahi rakho.

8. Quick check

Q1. Ek core 100% aur baaki idle — sabse likely kaaran?

  • Too many threads
  • Infinite loop (ek thread phasa)
  • GC pressure

Sahi jawab: Infinite loop (ek thread phasa) — Ek thread 100% kha raha hai — stack trace se dekho kaunsi line par loop ghoom raha hai.

Q2. Context switches 80,000/sec — kya galat hai?

  • CPU slow hai
  • Threads bahut zyada hain
  • Memory kam hai

Sahi jawab: Threads bahut zyada hain — Zyada threads = CPU kaam se zyada switch me — thread pool size kam karo.

Guide ki poori list — 100% CPU ke 9 kaaran (original se)

  1. Infinite Loops — loop kabhi khatm hi nahi hota, CPU ghumta rehta hai.
  2. Background Processes — peeche chal rahe processes chup-chaap CPU kha rahe hote hain.
  3. High Traffic Volume — achanak zyada requests aa gayi, server handle nahi kar pa raha.
  4. Resource-Intensive Applications — bhaari applications jo bahut CPU maangti hain.
  5. Insufficient Memory — memory kam hai to system baar-baar swap/GC karta hai, CPU badh jata hai.
  6. Concurrent Processes — ek saath bahut saare processes chal rahe hain.
  7. Busy Waiting — process wait karne ki bajay baar-baar check karta rehta hai (spin lock jaisa).
  8. Regular Expression Matching — bura regex bahut bada input scan karke CPU kha jata hai.
  9. Malware and Viruses — malware chhup kar CPU use karta hai.

In 9 ko samajh lo to diagnose karna aasan hai — pehle top/htop se kaun sa process CPU kha raha hai ye dekho, phir usi kaaran par focus karo.

Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/top-9-cases-behind-100-cpu-usage.md

09DevTools and Productivity

Top 6 Tools to Turn Code into Beautiful Diagrams

Code se sundar diagram banana ab aasan hai — 6 tools hain jo code, text ya AI se professional diagrams banate hain. Ye page har tool ko samjhata hai: kya karta hai, kab use karein, aur kaunsa free hai.

1. Top 6 Tools to Turn Code into Beautiful Diagrams — aasan bhasha me

Code se diagram banana aisa hai jaise khana banane ke liye alag-alag bartan: Mermaid aisa hai jaise pressure cooker — tez aur simple; PlantUML aisa hai jaise pura kitchen set — sab kuch banta hai par setup zyada; AI tools aise hain jaise swiggy — bolo kya chahiye, bana kar de dega, par jaisa chahiye waisa na bhi ho. Har bartan ka apna kaam hai — sabse achha cook wahi jo sahi bartan chunta hai.

Yaad rakhna: tool se zyada diagram ki clarity matter karti hai. Sundar par confusing diagram, simple par saaf diagram se bekar hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Mermaid

Mermaid — text se flowchart, sequence, class, ER diagrams. GitHub, Notion, Obsidian me native support. Seekhne me 10 minute. Free aur open source.

Best: docs, README, design docs. Limit: layout control kam — bade diagrams me boxes overlap kar sakte hain.

Sahi: har design doc me Mermaid diagram — Git diff bhi dikhta hai.
Galat: pixel-perfect presentation diagram Mermaid me banana — wo Draw.io ka kaam hai.

PlantUML

PlantUML — UML diagrams ka raja: sequence, class, use-case, activity, C4. Text se banta hai, bahut saare IDEs me integrated. Free, open source.

Best: sequence diagrams, C4 architecture. Limit: Java-based, render ke liye server ya plugin chahiye.

Sahi: API flow samjhane ke liye sequence diagram — PlantUML best hai.
Galat: simple flowchart ke liye PlantUML — Mermaid tez hai.

D2 / Graphviz

D2 — modern diagram language, Mermaid se zyada layout control, phir bhi text-based. Graphviz (DOT) — sabse purana, powerful layout algorithms, dependency graphs aur complex networks ke liye best.

Best: D2 — general diagrams jahan layout matter kare; Graphviz — bade dependency graphs, compiler/IR visualization.

Sahi: code ka dependency graph nikalna ho to Graphviz.
Galat: D2/Graphviz ko docs me daalna jahan team Mermaid use karti hai — standard ek rakho.

AI tools

Eraser AI, DiagramGPT, ChatGPT + Mermaid — text description se diagram banao. 'User login flow banao' likho, AI Mermaid code dega. Eraser AI whiteboard + AI diagrams deta hai, team collaboration ke saath.

Best: jaldi draft banana, brainstorming. Limit: AI ka diagram hamesha sahi nahi hota — arrows galat, components missing. Hamesha review karo.

Sahi: AI se draft lo, khud refine karo — 80% kaam AI, 20% tumhara.
Galat: AI diagram ko bina check kiye design doc me daal dena.

Draw.io / Excalidraw

Draw.io (diagrams.net) — drag-drop, pixel-perfect, free. Excalidraw — hand-drawn style, rough sketches aur brainstorming ke liye best, JSON export hota hai.

Best: presentation diagrams (Draw.io), whiteboard sessions (Excalidraw). Limit: binary/XML files — Git diff nahi dikhta.

Sahi: client presentation ke liye Draw.io, team discussion ke liye Excalidraw.
Galat: har architecture diagram Draw.io me — update karna mushkil, stale ho jata hai.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

6 tools — ek table me

ToolTypeBest forPrice
MermaidText → diagramDocs, READMEFree
PlantUMLText → UMLSequence, C4Free
D2Text → diagramLayout controlFree
GraphvizText → graphDependency graphsFree
Eraser AIAI → diagramDraft, brainstormFreemium
Draw.ioDrag-dropPresentationFree

Kaunsa tool kab?

Docs/README me diagram        → Mermaid
Sequence diagram (API flow)   → PlantUML
Jaldi draft / brainstorm      → AI tools (Eraser/ChatGPT)
Presentation ke liye sundar   → Draw.io
Rough sketch / discussion     → Excalidraw
Dependency graph              → Graphviz

4. Try karo — diagram banao, tool chuno

Apni situation chuno — simulator batayega kaunsa tool best hai aur kyun.

  1. README me diagram chahiye
  2. API ka sequence diagram
  3. Client ko presentation
  4. Jaldi draft chahiye

5. Comparison — ek table me

CheezText-based (Mermaid etc.)Drag-drop (Draw.io)
Git diffDikhta haiNahi dikhta
SpeedTez (likhna)Slow (kheenchna)
Layout controlKamPoora
SeekhnaSyntax seekhni haiTurant

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Har diagram ke liye alag tool — team me ek standard rakho.
  2. AI diagram ko bina review kiye doc me daalna — arrows galat ho sakte hain.
  3. Presentation diagram ko text tool me banana — layout ke liye Draw.io hai.
  4. Diagram bana kar update na karna — stale diagram galat guide karta hai.
  5. Sundar par confusing diagram — clarity pehle, beauty baad me.

7. Interview corner

Q: Code se diagram banane ke fayde kya hain?

Git versioning, PR review, diff dikhta hai, aur badlav ek line ka hota hai. Drag-drop me diagram binary hoti hai — na diff, na review, aur update karna mushkil. Isiliye docs aur design docs me Mermaid/PlantUML use karte hain.

Q: Mermaid aur Draw.io me kab kya use karte ho?

Mermaid docs/README ke liye — GitHub render karta hai, review hota hai. Draw.io presentation ke liye — pixel-perfect layout chahiye to drag-drop hi sahi hai. Dono ka kaam alag hai.

Q: AI diagram tools par bharosa kar sakte ho?

Draft ke liye haan, final ke liye nahi. AI 80% sahi diagram deta hai — arrows, labels ya components me galti ho sakti hai. Hamesha review karo aur refine karo.

8. Quick check

Q1. README me diagram ke liye best tool?

  • Draw.io
  • Mermaid
  • Photoshop

Sahi jawab: Mermaid — Mermaid GitHub me native render hota hai aur Git diff bhi dikhta hai.

Q2. Sequence diagram ke liye sabse achha text tool?

  • Mermaid
  • PlantUML
  • Excalidraw

Sahi jawab: PlantUML — PlantUML sequence aur UML diagrams ke liye sabse powerful hai.

Guide ki poori list — code se diagram banane ke 6 tools (original se)

  1. Diagrams — Python se cloud architecture diagrams.
  2. Go Diagrams — Go language se diagrams banane ka tool.
  3. Mermaid — Markdown jaisi simple syntax se flowcharts aur diagrams.
  4. PlantUML — text se UML diagrams (sequence, class, use-case).
  5. ASCII diagrams — sirf text characters se bane diagrams, code comments aur docs me chalte hain.
  6. Markmap — Markdown ko interactive mind-map me badal deta hai.

← PichhlaTop 9 Causes of 100% CPU UsageAgla →Tools for Shipping Code to Production
10DevTools and Productivity

Tools for Shipping Code to Production

Code production me kaise jata hai? Team chhoti ho ya badi, tools alag hote hain — par pipeline ek jaisi hoti hai: code → test → build → deploy → monitor. Ye page team size ke hisaab se shipping tools ko samjhata hai.

1. Tools for Shipping Code to Production — aasan bhasha me

Code ship karna aisa hai jaise khana restaurant me serve karna: chhote dhabe me ek cook sab karta hai (1-10 log — GitHub + Vercel), medium restaurant me alag sections hote hain (10-100 log — CI/CD + staging), aur bade hotel me poora system hota hai (1000+ log — Kubernetes + observability + feature flags). Khana wahi hai, system size ke hisaab se badalta hai.

Yaad rakhna: tools team size ke hisaab se badalte hain, pipeline nahi. Har size par chahiye: version control, automated tests, review, deploy, aur monitoring.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

1-10 log

Chhoti team: GitHub + Vercel/Netlify + GitHub Actions. Push karo, preview deploy ban jata hai, tests chalte hain, merge karte hi production live. Koi server manage nahi karna.

Tools: GitHub (code + PR), Actions (CI), Vercel/Render (hosting), Sentry (errors), PostHog (analytics). Sab managed — team code par focus kare, infra par nahi.

Sahi: managed services — 2 log infra sambhalne me time waste na karen.
Galat: 3 logon ki team Kubernetes chalaye — ops hi poora sprint kha jayega.

10-100 log

Medium team: CI/CD pipeline + staging + Docker. Jenkins/GitHub Actions se build-test-deploy, staging environment jahan QA hota hai, Docker se har jagah same environment.

Tools: Docker + GitHub Actions/Jenkins, staging env, SonarQube (code quality), Sentry, Datadog (monitoring). PR par auto tests + preview env.

Sahi: staging = production jaisa — wahan test karo, production par surprise nahi.
Galat: staging ko production se alag rakhna — 'staging par to chal raha tha' wali galti.

100-1000 log

Badi team: Kubernetes + service mesh + feature flags + canary. Kai teams, kai services — deploy alag-alag, canary release (pehle 5% users), feature flags se bina deploy ke feature on/off.

Tools: Kubernetes, ArgoCD (GitOps), LaunchDarkly (flags), Prometheus/Grafana, PagerDuty (alerts). Deploy din me kai baar, bina darr ke.

Sahi: canary + flags — kharab release ko 5 minute me wapas lo, bina redeploy.
Galat: bina flags ke big-bang deploy — ek bug matlab poora rollback.

1000+ log

Enterprise: platform team + internal tools + compliance. Developer platform (IDP) jahan team khud service bana sakti hai, automated security scans, audit logs, multi-region deploy.

Tools: Backstage (IDP), Terraform (infra as code), Vault (secrets), SIEM (security), multi-region + disaster recovery drills. Har deploy audited, har change traceable.

Sahi: platform team — baaki teams ko self-service, ticket ka wait nahi.
Galat: har deploy ke liye manual approval — release hafte me ek baar reh jayegi.

Quality

Har size par code quality tools: linters (ESLint, Ruff), formatters (Prettier, Black), type checkers (TypeScript, mypy), tests (unit, integration, e2e), security scans (Dependabot, Snyk).

Quality gate: PR merge tabhi ho jab tests pass + lint clean + coverage na gire. Ye gate CI me lagao, logo ki yaad par nahi.

Sahi: quality gates CI me — merge tabhi jab sab green ho.
Galat: 'jaldi hai, test skip kar do' — production par bug 10x mehenga padta hai.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Pipeline — har size par ek jaisi

Code (Git) → PR + Review → CI (test/lint/build)
  → Staging (QA) → Deploy (canary/rolling)
  → Monitor (errors, metrics) → Rollback (agar gadbad)

Chhoti team: ye sab Vercel/Actions me automatic.
Badi team: ye sab Kubernetes/ArgoCD me, par steps wahi.

Tools by team size

Cheez1-1010-100100-10001000+
HostingVercel/RenderDocker + cloudKubernetesMulti-region K8s
CI/CDGitHub ActionsActions/JenkinsArgoCDGitOps + IDP
DeployAuto on mergeStaging → prodCanary + flagsProgressive delivery
MonitorSentryDatadogPrometheusFull observability

4. Try karo — apni team ke liye pipeline banao

Team size chuno — simulator batayega kaunse tools chahiye aur pipeline kaisi hogi.

  1. Team: 5 log
  2. Team: 50 log
  3. Team: 500 log
  4. Team: 5000 log

5. Comparison — ek table me

PracticeChhoti teamBadi team
Deploy frequencyHar merge parDin me kai baar, per-service
Release riskLow (chhota blast radius)Canary + flags se control
RollbackRedeploy / revertFlag off / traffic shift
Review1 reviewerCODEOWNERS + auto checks

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Chhoti team par enterprise tools thopna — Kubernetes 3 logon ke liye overkill hai.
  2. Staging ko production se alag rakhna — 'staging par chal raha tha' wali galti.
  3. Quality gates na lagana — tests optional rakhna matlab tests kabhi nahi chalenge.
  4. Bina canary/flags ke big-bang deploy — ek bug = poora rollback.
  5. Monitoring ko baad me sochna — deploy ke din hi errors dikhni chahiye.

7. Interview corner

Q: Team size ke hisaab se shipping tools kaise badalte hain?

Pipeline wahi rehti hai — code, test, deploy, monitor. Chhoti team managed services (Vercel, Actions) use karti hai; medium team Docker + staging jodti hai; badi team Kubernetes + canary + feature flags; enterprise me platform team aur compliance aata hai. Tools size ke saath badalte hain, steps nahi.

Q: Canary deployment kya hai, kyun use karte hain?

Naya version pehle chhote % users (5%) ko do, monitor karo — error rate ya latency badhe to turant wapas lo. 100% ek saath dene se ek bug saare users ko affect karta hai; canary se blast radius chhota rehta hai.

Q: Feature flags kyun use karte hain?

Bina redeploy ke feature on/off karne ke liye. Release aur rollout alag ho jate hain — code deploy karo, flag se dheere-dheere users ko do. Kharab feature ho to flag band karo, rollback ki zaroorat nahi.

8. Quick check

Q1. 5 logon ki team ke liye best hosting kya hai?

  • Self-managed Kubernetes
  • Vercel/Render jaise managed services
  • Apna data center

Sahi jawab: Vercel/Render jaise managed services — Chhoti team ko code par focus karna chahiye — infra managed service sambhale.

Q2. Canary deployment ka matlab?

  • Poora traffic ek saath naye version par
  • Pehle 5% users, monitor, phir 100%
  • Deploy hi mat karo

Sahi jawab: Pehle 5% users, monitor, phir 100% — Chhote group par test karo — bug mile to nuksaan chhota, wapas lena aasan.

Guide ke khaas points — company size ke hisaab se tools (original se)

Ek hi solution sabke liye nahi hota — approach company ke size par depend karta hai:

Company sizeKya hota hai
1–10 employeesProduct-market fit dhoondhne par focus. Delivery aur experimentation sabse important. Free ya low-cost tools use karo, developers khud testing aur deployment sambhalte hain, customer feedback par close nazar rakho.
10–100 employeesProduct-market fit mil gaya to scale karna hai. Critical features ki quality par invest karo, scheduled deployments aur testing processes banao, customer support processes aur proactive alerts lagao.
100–1,000 employeesGo-to-market strategy kaam kar gayi to engineering efficiency optimize karo. Commercial tools khareedo, jaise Atlassian products. Tools me standardization lao aur automation use karo.
1,000–10,000+ employeesBadi tech companies khud experimental tooling aur automation banati hain. Netflix apni "Test in Production" strategy ke liye mashhoor hai — sab kuch experiments se test hota hai.
