← PichhlaTop 6 Tools to Turn Code into Beautiful DiagramsAgla →Making Sense of Search Engine Optimization
11DevTools and Productivity

Making Sense of Search Engine Optimization

SEO matlab tumhari website Google me dikhe — warna duniya ki best website bhi koi nahi dekhega. Ye page SEO ko 4 hisso me samjhata hai: structure, keywords, page optimization aur links — bina jargon ke, practical steps ke saath.

1. Making Sense of Search Engine Optimization — aasan bhasha me

SEO aisa hai jaise ek dukaan ko main bazaar me lagana: pehle dukaan ka board saaf ho (title/meta), andar samaan theek se saja ho (structure), log wahi poochhein jo tum bechte ho (keywords), aur aas-pados ki dukaanen tumhari taraf ishara karein (backlinks). Dukaan achhi ho par gali ke andar chhupi ho to koi nahi aayega — SEO wahi main bazaar tak le jane ka kaam hai.

Yaad rakhna: SEO ek din ka kaam nahi — Google ko tumhari site samajhne aur bharosa karne me hafte-mahine lagte hain. Shortcut (keyword stuffing, kharide hue links) se penalty milti hai, ranking nahi.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Structure

Website structure — Google ka crawler tumhari site ko ghum kar samajhta hai. Saaf structure matlab: logical URLs (/blog/seo-guide), sitemap.xml, robots.txt, internal linking (har page 3 clicks ke andar), aur fast loading.

Mobile-first: Google pehle mobile version dekhta hai. Page 3 second se zyada load ho to ranking aur users dono girte hain. Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) ab ranking factor hain.

Sahi: sitemap + saaf URLs + internal links + 2 sec se kam load time.
Galat: JavaScript par poori site — crawler ko content hi nahi dikhega.

Keywords

Keywords — wo words jo users Google me type karte hain. Research karo: Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs, ya khud Google par search karke 'People also ask' dekho. Long-tail keywords (jaise 'best budget laptop for students India') par rank karna aasan hai, 'laptop' par nahi.

Ek page = ek main keyword + related keywords. Keyword ko title, pehle paragraph, headings aur URL me natural tareeke se rakho — zabardasti bharna (stuffing) penalty deta hai.

Sahi: user ki intent samjho — wo khareedna chahta hai ya seekhna? Us hisaab se content likho.
Galat: har jagah keyword bharna — Google samajh jata hai, aur user bhi bhaag jayega.

Page (on-page)

On-page SEO — har page par: title tag (60 chars, keyword aage), meta description (155 chars, click karne layak), headings (ek H1, logical H2/H3), images (alt text + compress), aur content (gehra, original, user ke sawal ka jawab).

Schema markup (JSON-LD) se Google ko samjhao ye page kya hai — recipe, product, FAQ. FAQ schema se search me rich results milte hain.

Sahi: title aur meta har page par alag — duplicate meta Google ko confuse karta hai.
Galat: AI se 100 thin pages banana — Google thin content ko rank nahi karta.

Links

External links (backlinks) — dusri sites tumhari taraf link karein to Google ko lagta hai tum bharosemand ho. Quality matters: ek achhi site ka link 100 spammy links se behtar hai. Guest posts, useful tools, original research — ye natural links late hain.

Internal links bhi utne hi important: related pages ko jodo, taaki crawler aur user dono ghoom sakein. Broken links (404) hatate raho — Search Console me dikhte hain.

Sahi: useful content banao — links khud aate hain. Digital PR aur original data best link magnets hain.
Galat: links khareedna ya link farms — Google penalty deta hai, kabhi-kabhi de-index bhi kar deta hai.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

SEO checklist — har page ke liye

CheezRule
Title tag50-60 chars, keyword aage, har page alag
Meta description150-160 chars, click karne layak
URLChhota, readable, keyword ho
H1Ek hi, page ka topic
ImagesAlt text + compressed (<100KB)
Load time2 sec se kam (mobile par)
Internal linksHar page se 2-3 relevant pages

SEO tools

Google Search Console — free, ranking + errors + clicks
Google Analytics     — kaunsa page kitna traffic lata hai
Ahrefs / Semrush     — keywords + backlinks (paid)
PageSpeed Insights   — speed aur Core Web Vitals
Screaming Frog       — poori site crawl karke errors dhoondho

4. Try karo — apna page SEO-check karo

Ek sample page check karo — simulator batayega SEO score aur kya sudharna hai.

  1. Title check karo
  2. Speed check karo
  3. Links check karo
  4. Poora audit karo

5. Comparison — ek table me

SEO typeKya haiExample
TechnicalSite ka structureSitemap, speed, mobile
On-pageHar page ka contentTitle, headings, keywords
Off-pageBahar se signalsBacklinks, brand mentions
LocalLocation searchGoogle Business Profile

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Keyword stuffing — Google penalty deta hai, user bhi bhaag jata hai.
  2. Links khareedna — de-index tak ho sakta hai.
  3. Title 'Home' rakhna — har page ka title alag aur keyword wala hona chahiye.
  4. Speed ignore karna — 3 sec se zyada load = aadhe users chale gaye.
  5. SEO ko ek baar ka kaam samajhna — ye continuous process hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: SEO kya hai aur kaise kaam karta hai?

Search Engine Optimization — website ko Google me upar lane ka kaam. 3 hisse: technical (structure, speed), on-page (title, content, keywords), off-page (backlinks). Google crawler site ko padhta hai, 200+ signals se rank karta hai. Results hafte-mahine me dikhte hain.

Q: On-page aur off-page SEO me farq?

On-page tumhare control me hai — title, meta, headings, content, images, speed. Off-page bahar se aata hai — backlinks, brand mentions, social signals. Dono chahiye: achha content bina links ke nahi rank karta, links bina achhe content ke penalty dete hain.

Q: Core Web Vitals kya hain?

Google ke speed metrics: LCP (sabse bada content kitni der me dikha), CLS (page kitna hilta hai load hote time), INP (click ka jawab kitni der me). Ye ranking factor hain — slow page rank nahi karta, chahe content achha ho.

8. Quick check

Q1. Sabse important on-page cheez kya hai?

  • Keyword stuffing
  • Alag title + meta har page par
  • 100 backlinks khareedna

Sahi jawab: Alag title + meta har page par — Har page ka alag, keyword wala title aur meta — Google aur user dono ko samajh aata hai page kis baare me hai.

Q2. Backlinks me kya matter karta hai?

  • Sirf number
  • Quality — achhi site ka ek link 100 spammy se behtar
  • Links chhupana

Sahi jawab: Quality — achhi site ka ek link 100 spammy se behtar — Google quality dekhta hai — ek reputed site ka link bahut powerful hota hai.

Guide ke khaas points — search engine kaise kaam karta hai (original se)

Search engine 3 stages me kaam karta hai:

  • Crawler: page ka content (HTML code) padhta hai aur hyperlink follow karke aur pages padhta hai.
  • Preprocessor (ye bhi 3 steps me): pehle HTML tags aur 'stop' words (jaise 'a', 'an', 'the') aur bekaar noise (jaise disclaimer) hata deta hai; phir keywords se structured indices bante hain — forward indices aur inverted indices; phir hyperlink relationships calculate karta hai — page par kitne hyperlinks hain aur kitne hyperlinks us page ki taraf point karte hain.
  • Ranking: user search term type karta hai to search engine indices aur ranking algorithms se pages ko rank karke results dikhata hai.

Website ko upar rank karane ke tareeke

  • Website structure optimize karo: crawler ke liye aasan banao — flash, frames aur dynamic URLs hatao jo crawler padh nahi sakta. Website hierarchy kam deep rakho taaki pages home page se zyada door na hon.
  • URLs chhoti aur descriptive rakho: URLs me keywords daalo. HTTPS use karo. URL me underscore (_) use mat karo — wo tokenization kharab kar deta hai.
  • Keywords sahi chuno: keyword relevant hona chahiye aur business value honi chahiye — jaise popular search ho par kam search results hon, wo keyword valuable hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/making-sense-of-search-engine-optimization.md
← PichhlaTools for Shipping Code to ProductionAgla →Most Used Linux Commands Map
12DevTools and Productivity

Most Used Linux Commands Map

Linux commands hazaaron hain — par roz ke kaam ke liye 30-40 kaafi hain. Ye page sabse zyada use hone wale Linux commands ko 7 groups me samjhata hai, examples ke saath, taaki terminal tumhara dost ban jaye.

1. Most Used Linux Commands Map — aasan bhasha me

Linux terminal aisa hai jaise ek workshop: har command ek auzaar hai — hammer (ls), saw (grep), screwdriver (chmod). Pehle din sab auzaar ajeeb lagte hain, par jab pata chalta hai kaunsa auzaar kis kaam ka hai, to kaam 10x tez ho jata hai. GUI se har kaam mouse se hota hai; terminal se ek line me wohi kaam jo GUI me 10 click me hota hai.

Yaad rakhna: har command ke saath --help ya man <command> chalao — manual built-in hai. Aur history se purane commands wapas milte hain.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Files & dirs

ls (list), cd (change dir), pwd (kahan ho), mkdir (folder banao), cp (copy), mv (move/rename), rm (delete), touch (khali file).

Useful flags: ls -la (chhupi files + details), cp -r (folder copy), rm -rf (dhyaan se — bina poochhe delete!). find se file dhoondho, du -sh se folder ka size dekho.

Sahi: rm -rf se pehle ls se dekho kya delete ho raha hai.
Galat: rm -rf / ya rm -rf * galat folder me — sab ud jayega.

View & edit

cat (poori file dikhao), less (scroll karke dekho), head/tail (shuru/aakhir ki lines), tail -f (live logs dekho), nano/vim (edit karo).

grep sabse powerful: grep -r "error" /var/log — poore folder me 'error' dhoondho. grep -i case ignore, grep -n line number dikhata hai.

Sahi: logs dekhne ke liye tail -f app.log | grep ERROR — live errors dikhengi.
Galat: badi file ko cat se kholna — terminal bhar jayega, less use karo.

Processes

ps aux (kaunsi process chal rahi hai), top/htop (live CPU/memory), kill <pid> (process band karo), kill -9 (force), jobs/bg/fg (background jobs).

systemctl status nginx se service ki haalat, journalctl -u nginx se uske logs. Process ka PID ps se milta hai.

Sahi: pehle kill (graceful), kaam na kare to kill -9.
Galat: kill -9 seedha — process ko cleanup ka mauka nahi milta.

System info

uname -a (kernel + system), df -h (disk kitna bacha hai), free -h (memory), uptime (kab se chal raha hai), whoami, hostname.

Disk full hona sabse common production problem hai — df -h pehle chalao, phir du -sh /* se dekho kahan bhar gaya.

Sahi: df -h aur free -h — roz ki health check, 5 second ka kaam.
Galat: disk full hone par logs delete karna bina samjhe — pehle dekho kya bhar raha hai.

Users & groups

whoami, id, sudo (admin bankar chalao), su (user badlo), useradd, passwd (password badlo), groups.

sudo se command admin rights se chalti hai — bina sudo ke system files edit nahi hoti. Har command par sudo mat lagao, sirf jahan zaroorat ho.

Sahi: roz ka kaam normal user se, system kaam sudo se.
Galat: hamesha root bankar kaam karna — ek galti poora system kharab kar sakti hai.

Network

ping (server zinda hai?), curl (URL se data lao), wget (file download), ssh user@host (remote server par jao), scp (file bhejo), netstat/ss -tulpn (kaunse ports khule hain).

curl -I https://example.com se sirf headers dekho. ssh ke liye key-based auth use karo — password se zyada safe.

Sahi: curl se API test karo — Postman kholne ki zaroorat nahi.
Galat: production server par password auth — key-based auth + fail2ban lagao.

Packages

apt update && apt install <pkg> (Ubuntu/Debian), yum/dnf install (RedHat), snap install. Update pehle, install baad me — warna purana version milega.

apt search <name> se package dhoondho, apt remove se hatao. Production par apt upgrade dhyaan se — pehle staging par test karo.

Sahi: apt update phir apt install — hamesha is order me.
Galat: random scripts internet se curl | bash karke chalana — pehle script padho.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Roz ke kaam — command table

KaamCommand
Files dekhols -la
File dhoondhofind . -name "*.log"
Text dhoondhogrep -rn "TODO" .
Disk dekhodf -h
Memory dekhofree -h
Process dekhops aux | grep nginx
Live logstail -f /var/log/syslog
Remote serverssh user@host

Pipes aur redirection — terminal ki jaan

ps aux | grep nginx     # output ko agle command me bhejo
ls > files.txt         # output file me likho
cat file | sort | uniq # chain banao — har command ek filter

Ye teen symbols ( | > >> ) seekh lo to terminal 10x powerful.

4. Try karo — terminal chalao

Neeche commands chalao — simulator batayega kya output aayega aur kya hoga.

  1. ls -la
  2. df -h
  3. grep -r ERROR /var/log
  4. rm -rf (galti!)

5. Comparison — ek table me

GroupMain commandsRoz use?
Filesls, cd, cp, mv, rmHaan, roz
View/editcat, grep, tail, vimHaan, roz
Processesps, top, kill, systemctlDebug me
Systemdf, free, unameHealth check
Networkping, curl, ssh, scpRoz
Packagesapt, yumSetup me

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. rm -rf bina dekhe chalana — sabse khatarnak command.
  2. Har command par sudo lagana — root bankar galti mehenga padta hai.
  3. curl | bash bina script padhe — koi bhi code chala sakta hai.
  4. Logs ko cat se kholna — less ya tail use karo.
  5. man pages na padhna — har command ka manual built-in hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: Sabse zyada use hone wale Linux commands kaunse hain?

ls, cd, grep, find, ps, top, df, free, tail, ssh, curl, chmod, systemctl. Aur pipes (|) aur grep — inke bina terminal aadha hai. Interview me sirf naam nahi, ek example bhi do — jaise grep -rn se logs me error dhoondhna.

Q: Disk full ho to kaise debug karte ho?

Pehle df -h se dekho kaunsa disk full hai, phir du -sh /* se kaunsa folder bhar raha hai. Aksar logs ya /tmp hota hai. Logs ko rotate karo (logrotate), purane delete karo — par pehle samjho kya bhar raha hai, blindly delete mat karo.

Q: grep aur find me kya farq hai?

find files dhoondhta hai (naam, size, date se), grep file ke andar text dhoondhta hai. Dono saath me chalte hain: find se .log files nikalo, grep se unme ERROR dhoondho.

8. Quick check

Q1. Live logs dekhne ka command?

  • cat app.log
  • tail -f app.log
  • ls -la

Sahi jawab: tail -f app.log — tail -f nayi lines aate hi dikhata hai — live monitoring ke liye best hai.

Q2. Disk kitna bacha hai — kaunsa command?

  • free -h
  • df -h
  • ps aux

Sahi jawab: df -h — df -h disk usage dikhata hai; free -h memory dikhata hai.

Guide ke khaas points — Linux commands ki 7 categories (original se)

Guide ka map sabse zyada use hone wale Linux commands ko unke kaam ke hisaab se 7 categories me baant ta hai:

  1. File and Directory Management — files aur folders banana, move karna, delete karna.
  2. File Viewing and Editing — files dekhna aur edit karna.
  3. Process Management — chal rahe processes dekhna, rokna, manage karna.
  4. System Information — system ke baare me jaankari nikalna.
  5. User and Group Management — users aur groups banana aur manage karna.
  6. Network Configuration and Monitoring — network setup aur monitoring.
  7. Package Management — software install, update aur remove karna.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/most-used-linux-commands-map.md

13DevTools and Productivity

Linux File Permissions Illustrated

Linux file permissions — rwx, 755, chmod — har developer ko aane chahiye. Ye page batata hai ownership kya hai, permission kaise kaam karti hai, aur 'Permission denied' aaye to kya karein.

1. Linux File Permissions Illustrated — aasan bhasha me

Linux permissions aise hain jaise ek ghar ki chaabiyan: Owner ghar ka malik hai, Group parivaar hai, Others bahar ke log hain. Har darwaze par likha hai kaun andar aa sakta hai (read), kaun samaan badal sakta hai (write), aur kaun andar ja kar kaam kar sakta hai (execute). Galat chaabi kisi ko de di to ya to kaam ruk jayega, ya koi tumhara samaan badal jayega.

Yaad rakhna: 'Permission denied' ka matlab system tumhe rok raha hai — ye bug nahi, security hai. Fix ye hai ki permission sahi karo, chmod 777 karke sab khol dena nahi.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Ownership

Har file ka ek owner (user) aur ek group hota hai. ls -l se dikhta hai: -rw-r--r-- 1 asha devs file.txt — owner asha, group devs. chown user:group file se owner badlo, chgrp group file se group.

Web server ki files ka owner aksar www-data hota hai — taaki server unhe padh sake, par koi aur badal na sake. Owner galat ho to server file padh hi nahi payega.

Sahi: chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www — poori site ka owner server user ko do.
Galat: sab kuch root ka rakhna aur server ko root se chalana — security risk.

rwx

r (read=4), w (write=2), x (execute=1) — teen permissions, teen logon ke liye: owner, group, others. -rwxr-xr-x matlab owner ko sab, group aur others ko read+execute.

File par x matlab chala sakte ho; folder par x matlab andar ja sakte ho (aur r bina x ke folder ki listing nahi dikhti). Numbers me: 755 = rwxr-xr-x, 644 = rw-r--r--, 600 = rw-------.

Sahi: files 644, folders 755, scripts 755, secrets 600 — ye standard hai.
Galat: chmod 777 — sabko sab kuch; ye security ka darwaza khol dena hai.

chmod

chmod se permission badlo — do tareeke: numeric (chmod 755 file) ya symbolic (chmod u+x file — owner ko execute do, chmod g-w file — group se write lo).

chmod -R se poora folder badlo — dhyaan se, kyunki wapas lana mushkil hota hai. Pehle ls -l se current permission dekho.

Sahi: chmod +x deploy.sh — script ko executable banao, bas itna hi.
Galat: chmod -R 777 /var/www — poori site sabke liye khuli.

Special bits

Teen special permissions: setuid (4) — file owner ki power se chalti hai; setgid (2) — folder me bani file group inherit karti hai; sticky bit (1) — /tmp jaisa folder jahan sab likh sakte hain par dusre ki file delete nahi kar sakte.

/tmp par 1777 hota hai — sab likh sakte hain, par sirf apni file delete kar sakte ho. passwd command setuid se chalti hai — isiliye normal user apna password badal sakta hai.

Sahi: shared folder par setgid — team ki files ka group ek jaisa rahe.
Galat: setuid apni script par lagana — security hole ban jata hai.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Permission numbers — yaad rakhne ka tareeka

r = 4,  w = 2,  x = 1   (jodo to permission banti hai)

7 = 4+2+1 = rwx     6 = 4+2 = rw-     5 = 4+1 = r-x
4 = r--               0 = --- (kuch nahi)

755 = owner rwx (7), group r-x (5), others r-x (5)
644 = owner rw- (6), group r-- (4), others r-- (4)
600 = owner rw- (6), group --- (0), others --- (0)

ls -l me: -rwxr-xr-x  =  file, 755
            drwxr-xr-x = folder, 755

Common setups

CheezPermissionKyun
Normal file644Sab padhein, sirf owner badle
Folder755Sab andar jayein, sirf owner badle
Script755Chalani hai, isiliye x chahiye
SSH key600Sirf owner — warna SSH mana kar deta hai
.env / secrets600Sirf owner padhe

4. Try karo — permission fix karo

Neeche permission problems aayengi — sahi chmod chuno aur dekho kya hota hai.

  1. Script chalani hai: Permission denied
  2. SSH key: UNPROTECTED PRIVATE KEY FILE
  3. chmod 777 kar doon?

5. Comparison — ek table me

NumberSymbolMatlabKahan use
755rwxr-xr-xOwner sab, baaki read+executeFolders, scripts
644rw-r--r--Owner read+write, baaki readNormal files
600rw-------Sirf ownerSSH keys, .env
777rwxrwxrwxSabko sab kuchKabhi nahi!

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. chmod 777 se har permission problem 'fix' karna — ye security khatam karna hai.
  2. SSH key ko 644 rakhna — SSH mana kar deta hai, aur key leak ka risk.
  3. Script par x bhoolna — 'Permission denied' ka sabse common kaaran.
  4. chown bina samjhe karna — owner badalne se pehle dekho kis ko chahiye.
  5. Folder par x na dena — andar ja hi nahi payenge, chahe r ho.

7. Interview corner

Q: 755 aur 644 me kya farq hai?

755 = rwxr-xr-x — folders aur scripts ke liye, kyunki execute chahiye (folder me andar jane ke liye, script chalane ke liye). 644 = rw-r--r-- — normal files ke liye, sirf read+write, execute nahi. Numbers: r=4, w=2, x=1 — jod kar bante hain.

Q: chmod 777 kyun galat hai?

777 matlab har user ko read, write aur execute — koi bhi tumhari files badal sakta hai, malware daal sakta hai. 'Permission denied' ka sahi fix ye hai ki dekho kis user ko kya chahiye aur sirf wahi do — aksar 755/644 kaafi hota hai.

Q: SSH key ki permission 600 kyun honi chahiye?

SSH key tumhari pehchan hai — agar dusra user use padh le to tumhare server me ghus sakta hai. Isiliye SSH khud check karta hai: key 600 se zyada khuli ho to mana kar deta hai. Secrets hamesha sirf owner ke liye rakho.

8. Quick check

Q1. Normal file ki standard permission kya hai?

  • 777
  • 644
  • 600

Sahi jawab: 644 — 644 — owner read+write, baaki sirf read. Execute file ko nahi chahiye.

Q2. Script chalane par 'Permission denied' aaye to kya karte ho?

  • chmod 777
  • chmod +x script
  • sudo rm script

Sahi jawab: chmod +x script — chmod +x se execute permission milti hai — 777 poora darwaza khol deta hai.

Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/linux-file-permission-illustrated.md
← PichhlaMost Used Linux Commands MapAgla →5 Important Components of Linux
14DevTools and Productivity

5 Important Components of Linux

Linux ke 5 important components — kernel, shell, filesystem, processes aur users — inhe samajh lo to poora OS samajh aayega. Ye page har component ko deep me kholta hai, unke beech ke connection ke saath.

1. 5 Important Components of Linux — aasan bhasha me

Linux aisa hai jaise ek sheher: Kernel nagar nigam hai (sadkein, bijli, paani — sab resources sambhalta hai), Shell nagar nigam ka office hai jahan tum application dete ho (commands), Filesystem sheher ka naksha hai (har cheez ki jagah), Processes sheher ke log hain (kaam karte hain), aur Users/Permissions pehchan-patra hain (kaun kya kar sakta hai). Ek bhi hissa samjhe bina sheher nahi chal sakta.

Yaad rakhna: Linux me sab kuch file hai — hardware, processes, network — sab / ke andar files ki tarah dikhte hain. Ye ek idea poora Linux samjha deta hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Kernel

Kernel OS ka core hai — hardware aur software ke beech ka bridge. Kaam: CPU scheduling (kaun kab chalega), memory management, device drivers, system calls, aur security.

Tumhara program kernel se seedha baat nahi karta — system calls se baat karta hai (read, write, open). Kernel mode aur user mode alag hain — user program hardware ko seedha nahi chhoo sakta, isiliye ek program ke crash se poora system nahi girta.

Sahi: dmesg se kernel messages dekho — hardware problems wahi dikhte hain.
Galat: kernel ko user program samajhna — kernel sabse neeche, sabse powerful layer hai.

Shell

Shell (bash, zsh, fish) tum aur kernel ke beech ka interpreter hai. Tum command likhte ho, shell use parse karke kernel se kaam karwata hai, aur result dikhata hai. Shell scripting se commands ko automate karo.

Shell me pipes (|), redirection (>), variables, aur loops hote hain — yehi shell ko programming language banata hai. .bashrc me apne aliases aur settings rakho.

Sahi: roz ke kaam ke liye alias banao — alias ll='ls -la'.
Galat: har kaam GUI se karna — automation ke liye shell hi hai.

Filesystem

Filesystem — Linux me sab kuch / se shuru hota hai: /home (users), /etc (config), /var/log (logs), /bin (commands), /proc (processes, virtual), /dev (devices).

Har cheez file hai — hardware bhi (/dev/sda disk hai), process bhi (/proc/1234). Isiliye cat aur echo se bahut kuch kiya ja sakta hai.

Sahi: FHS (Filesystem Hierarchy Standard) yaad rakho — config /etc me, logs /var/log me.
Galat: config files ko /home me chhupana — dusra admin dhoondh nahi payega.

Processes

Process — chal raha program. Har process ka PID hota hai, parent hota hai, memory hoti hai. ps se dekho, kill se band karo, systemd services ko manage karta hai.

Processes ke states: running, sleeping (I/O wait), stopped, zombie (khatam par parent ne hisaab nahi liya). Signals se process ko message bhejo — SIGTERM (aram se band ho), SIGKILL (turant).

Sahi: service fail ho to systemctl status phir journalctl — pehle dekho, phir restart karo.
Galat: zombie processes ko ignore karna — parent ko fix karo, warna badhte jayenge.

Users & security

Users, groups aur permissions — har file aur process ka owner hota hai. Root (UID 0) sab kuch kar sakta hai, baaki users sirf apna kaam. sudo se temporary admin power milti hai.

Security ka base: least privilege — har user/process ko sirf utna do jitna chahiye. Isi se ek compromised service poora system nahi le pati.

Sahi: roz ka kaam normal user se — root sirf jab zaroorat ho.
Galat: sab kuch root se chalana — ek galti, poora system khatre me.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

5 components — ek saath kaise kaam karte hain

Tum type karte ho: ls /home
  → Shell command parse karta hai
  → System call: kernel se kehta hai directory padho
  → Kernel filesystem (/home) se data lata hai
  → Kernel process ko result deta hai
  → Shell tumhe dikhata hai

Har command me ye 5 components ek saath kaam karte hain.

Important directories

DirectoryKya hai
/Root — sab kuch yahin se
/homeUsers ke files
/etcConfig files
/var/logLogs
/bin, /usr/binCommands
/procProcesses (virtual)
/devDevices
/tmpTemporary files

4. Try karo — Linux ke andar jhanko

Neeche commands chalao — dekho Linux ke 5 components kaise dikhte hain.

  1. Processes dekho: ps
  2. Filesystem: ls /
  3. Kernel messages: dmesg
  4. User kaun hai: id

5. Comparison — ek table me

ComponentKaamDebug tool
KernelHardware + resourcesdmesg
ShellCommands samajhnaecho, history
FilesystemFiles ki jagahls, df, find
ProcessesChalte hue programsps, top
UsersKaun kya kar sakta haiid, ls -l

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Kernel aur shell ko ek samajhna — kernel core hai, shell uska interface.
  2. Config files ko galat jagah rakhna — /etc standard hai.
  3. Root bankar roz ka kaam karna — least privilege bhoolna.
  4. Zombie processes ignore karna — parent fix karo.
  5. /proc ko asli files samajhna — wo virtual hai, kernel ki window hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: Linux ke main components kaunse hain?

Kernel (hardware + resources), Shell (commands ka interpreter), Filesystem (sab kuch / se, files ki tarah), Processes (chalte hue programs), aur Users/Permissions (kaun kya kar sakta hai). Har command me ye paanchon ek saath kaam karte hain.

Q: Linux me 'sab kuch file hai' ka matlab?

Hardware, processes, network — sab / ke andar file ki tarah dikhte hain. /dev/sda disk hai, /proc/1234 ek process hai. Isiliye cat, echo jaise simple tools se bahut kuch kiya ja sakta hai.

Q: Kernel mode aur user mode me farq?

Kernel mode me code hardware ko seedha chhoo sakta hai; user mode me nahi — system calls se kernel se kaam karwana padta hai. Isi separation se ek program ke crash se poora system nahi girta.

8. Quick check

Q1. Linux me sab kuch kya hai?

  • Process
  • File
  • Socket

Sahi jawab: File — Hardware, processes, sab / ke andar files ki tarah dikhte hain — ye Linux ka core idea hai.

Q2. Kernel ka kaam kya hai?

  • Commands type karna
  • Hardware aur resources sambhalna
  • Files banana

Sahi jawab: Hardware aur resources sambhalna — Kernel CPU, memory, drivers aur system calls sambhalta hai — OS ka core hai.

15 Open-Source Projects That Changed the World

15 open-source projects ne duniya badal di — Linux se lekar Python tak, Git se lekar Kubernetes tak. Ye page un projects ko 5 groups me samjhata hai, aur batata hai har ek ne kya badla.

1. 15 Open-Source Projects That Changed the World — aasan bhasha me

Open source aisa hai jaise ek gaon ka kuwaan: kisi ek ne khoda, par paani sab peete hain — aur har koi use gehra karne me madad karta hai. Linux ek aadmi ne shuru kiya tha, aaj duniya ke 90% servers usi par chalte hain. Tum jo bhi software use karte ho, uske peeche koi na koi open-source project hai.

Yaad rakhna: open source ka matlab 'free' nahi, matlab hai khula — code dekh sakte ho, badal sakte ho, seekh sakte ho. Isi liye aaj ka har developer in projects par khada hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Web dev

Linux, Apache/Nginx, Node.js, React — web ki buniyad. Linux servers chalata hai, Nginx requests serve karta hai, Node.js ne JavaScript ko server par la diya, React ne UI banana badal diya.

React (Meta, 2013) ne component-based UI popular kiya — aaj ki har badi site kisi na kisi component framework par hai. Node.js ne ek hi language se frontend + backend possible kiya.

Sahi: in projects ka code padho — React ka codebase best teacher hai.
Galat: ye sochna ki open source matlab bina support ke — bade projects ke peeche companies aur communities hoti hain.

Data

MySQL/PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Apache Spark, TensorFlow — data ki duniya. Postgres duniya ka sabse pasandida database ban gaya hai, Spark ne big data processing aasan kiya, TensorFlow ne machine learning ko sabke liye khola.

Postgres ka kamaal: ek hi database — relational, JSON, full-text search, GIS — sab karta hai. Isiliye 'just use Postgres' ek joke bhi hai aur advice bhi.

Sahi: Postgres seekh lo — 90% apps ke liye kaafi hai.
Galat: har naye database ke peeche bhaagna — pehle ek ko gehra seekho.

DevTools

Git, VS Code, Docker, Kubernetes — developer ke auzaar. Git ne version control badal diya, VS Code ne editor ko free aur powerful bana diya, Docker ne 'mere machine par to chal raha tha' khatam kiya, Kubernetes ne containers ko scale karna aasan kiya.

Git (2005, Linus Torvalds) — aaj bina Git ke professional development namumkin hai. Docker (2013) ne deployment ko 10x aasan kiya.

Sahi: Git + Docker seekhna — ye dono har job me kaam aayenge.
Galat: tools ko magic samajhna — Docker bhi Linux containers par hi hai, samajh kar use karo.

ML & Big Data

TensorFlow, PyTorch, Apache Kafka, Hadoop — AI aur big data ki buniyad. Kafka ne real-time data streaming badal di, PyTorch ne research me deep learning aasan kiya, Hadoop ne big data ka darwaza khola.

PyTorch aaj research ka standard hai, TensorFlow production ka. Kafka har badi company ke data pipeline me hai — LinkedIn ne banaya tha, ab Apache project hai.

Sahi: Kafka seekhna — event-driven systems ka core hai.
Galat: ML seekhne se pehle Python aur data structures skip karna.

DevOps

Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins — infra ki duniya. Terraform ne infrastructure ko code bana diya (IaC), Jenkins ne CI/CD popular kiya, Kubernetes ne deployment automate kiya.

Terraform se poora infra ek file me likho — server, network, database — aur ek command se banao ya mitao. Yehi DevOps ka core idea hai: infra bhi code hai.

Sahi: Terraform seekh lo — cloud ka kaam 10x aasan ho jata hai.
Galat: manual clicks se infra banana — dobara banana ho to phir se clicks.

7. Interview corner

Q: Open source ne software industry ko kaise badla?

Pehle har company ko sab kuch khud banana padta tha — OS, database, tools. Open source ne buniyad free kar di: Linux, Postgres, Git, Kubernetes — sab khule hain. Isse startups saste me bane, innovation tez hui, aur standards bane. Aaj ki har badi company open source par khadi hai.

Q: Tum open source me contribute kaise karte ho?

Chhote se shuru karo — docs fix, typo, good-first-issue. Phir bug fix, phir feature. Contribution se code review seekhne ko milta hai aur community me naam banta hai. Resume me bhi strong dikhta hai.

Q: Linux itna important kyun hai?

1991 me shuru hua free OS — aaj 90%+ servers, saare supercomputers, aur Android ka base Linux hai. Khula hone se har company use customize kar sakti hai, aur community ne use sabse stable bana diya.

20 Popular Open Source Projects Started by Big Companies

Google, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix, LinkedIn, RedHat — badi companies ne apne andar ke tools ko open source karke duniya ko diye. Ye page 20 aise projects ko samjhata hai, company ke hisaab se.

1. 20 Popular Open Source Projects Started by Big Companies — aasan bhasha me

Badi companies ka open source aisa hai jaise ek bade restaurant ka chef apni secret recipe sabko de de — kyunki recipe se zyada uski pehchan aur team banti hai. Google ne Kubernetes diya, Meta ne React diya, Netflix ne Chaos Monkey diya. In recipes se poori industry aage badhi — aur companies ko duniya bhar se contributors mile.

Yaad rakhna: companies open source isiliye karti hain kyunki unhe bhi fayda hai — standard banta hai, talent milta hai, aur community project ko behtar banati hai. Ye charity nahi, strategy hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Google

Google — Kubernetes, TensorFlow, Go, Angular, Bazel. Kubernetes (2014) ne container orchestration ka standard bana diya. Go language (2009) cloud aur DevOps ki pasand hai. TensorFlow ne ML sabke liye khola, Angular ne web apps badle.

Google ke projects ka pattern: apni internal problem ka solution, phir open source karke industry standard bana do. Kubernetes aaj CNCF ka sabse bada project hai.

Sahi: Go seekhna — cloud-native tools zyada tar Go me hain.
Galat: Google ka har project use karna — apni problem ke hisaab se chuno.

Meta

Meta (Facebook) — React, PyTorch, GraphQL, Jest. React (2013) ne UI banana badal diya, PyTorch research me ML ka standard hai, GraphQL ne APIs ka tareeka badla, Jest ne JavaScript testing aasan kiya.

Meta ke projects developer experience par focus karte hain — React ka 'learn once, write anywhere' aur GraphQL ka 'jo chahiye wahi mango'.

Sahi: React + GraphQL seekhna — modern web stack ka core hai.
Galat: GraphQL ko har API par lagana — simple REST kabhi-kabhi behtar hai.

Microsoft

Microsoft — VS Code, TypeScript, .NET Core. VS Code (2015) duniya ka sabse popular editor ban gaya, TypeScript ne JavaScript ko type-safe banaya, .NET Core ne Microsoft stack ko cross-platform kiya.

Microsoft ka transformation: closed se open — aaj wo sabse bade open-source contributors me se hai. VS Code ka extension ecosystem iska sabse bada fayda hai.

Sahi: TypeScript seekhna — bade codebase me types hi bachate hain.
Galat: TypeScript ko 'JavaScript with types' samajh kar any use karna.

Netflix

Netflix — Chaos Monkey, Hystrix, Eureka, Zuul. Chaos Monkey (2011) production me jaan-bujh kar servers marta hai — taaki system failure ke liye tayyar rahe. Ye Chaos Engineering ki shuruaat thi.

Netflix OSS microservices ka poora toolkit tha — aaj Spring Cloud ne bahut kuch apna liya hai. Unka idea: failure ko chhupao nahi, uske liye practice karo.

Sahi: Chaos Engineering ka idea apnao — game days se failover test karo.
Galat: production me bina bataye chaos karna — pehle staging par practice karo.

LinkedIn + RedHat

LinkedIn — Kafka, Samza. Kafka (2011) real-time data streaming ka standard hai. RedHat — OpenShift, Ansible, Fedora. Ansible ne automation ko simple banaya (YAML se), OpenShift Kubernetes ko enterprise-ready banata hai.

Kafka har badi company ke data pipeline me hai; Ansible DevOps engineers ka daily tool hai. Dono ka pattern: internal need se bana, phir industry standard bana.

Sahi: Kafka aur Ansible seekhna — data aur DevOps dono me kaam aayenge.
Galat: Kafka ko har chhote kaam me lagana — chhote queue ke liye SQS/RabbitMQ kaafi hai.

Linux File System Explained

Linux file system — /home, /etc, /var, /proc — har directory ka ek kaam hai. Ye page filesystem hierarchy ko deep me samjhata hai, taaki tumhe pata ho kaunsi cheez kahan dhoondhni hai.

1. Linux File System Explained — aasan bhasha me

Linux filesystem aisa hai jaise ek bade ghar ka layout: /home bedrooms hain (har user ka apna kamra), /etc office hai (saare rules aur config files), /var/log diary hai (kya hua, kab hua), /bin toolbox hai (auzaar), /tmp dustbin ke paas wali jagah hai (temporary samaan). Naye ghar me aakar bhi tumhe pata hona chahiye kitchen kahan hai — Linux me bhi wahi hai.

Yaad rakhna: Linux me sab kuch / (root) se shuru hota hai. Windows me C: aur D: alag hote hain; Linux me sab — disk, USB, network — ek hi ped (tree) me judte hain (mount hote hain).

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

/ (root)

/ — poore filesystem ki jad. Sab kuch isi ke neeche hai. Root directory me sirf standard folders hone chahiye — apni files yahan mat rakho.

Windows se farq: Windows me har drive ka apna letter (C:, D:) hota hai. Linux me dusri disk bhi kisi folder par mount hoti hai — jaise /mnt/data. Ek hi tree, sab kuch connected.

Sahi: ls / karke structure dekho — pehli baar me hi samajh aayega.
Galat: root (/) me files banana — permission bhi nahi milegi, aur galat bhi hai.

/home + /root

/home — users ke personal files. /home/asha tumhara ghar hai — documents, downloads, settings (.bashrc). /root — root user ka home, alag jagah, sirf admin ke liye.

Apni files hamesha /home me rakho — backup bhi aasan, aur dusre users se alag. Dotfiles (.bashrc, .gitconfig) bhi yahin hote hain.

Sahi: apna kaam /home/username me — backup aur permissions dono aasan.
Galat: /tmp me important files rakhna — reboot par saaf ho sakta hai.

/etc

/etc — system ki config files. /etc/passwd (users), /etc/hosts (DNS), /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (web server), /etc/ssh/sshd_config — sab yahin.

Config badalni ho to /etc me jao. Badalne se pehle backup lo (cp file file.bak) — ek galti aur service start nahi hogi.

Sahi: config edit se pehle .bak banao — wapas lana 1 second ka kaam.
Galat: /etc ki files ko bina backup edit karna.

/var + /tmp

/var — badalta hua data: /var/log (logs), /var/www (websites), /var/lib (databases ka data). /tmp — temporary files, reboot par saaf ho sakta hai.

Disk full hone par pehle /var/log dekho — logs hi sabse zyada bharte hain. logrotate se logs automatic ghumte hain (purane compress, naye bante hain).

Sahi: logs ke liye logrotate — disk kabhi logs se nahi bharega.
Galat: /tmp me important data rakhna — wo temporary jagah hai.

/bin + /usr

/bin — basic commands (ls, cp, cat). /usr/bin — baaki programs. /sbin — system/admin commands. /lib — libraries.

which python3 se dekho command kahan hai. PATH variable me ye directories hoti hain — isiliye ls likhte hi chalta hai, poora path nahi likhna padta.

Sahi: echo $PATH — samajh aayega command kaise milta hai.
Galat: /usr/bin me haath se files daalna — package manager ka kaam hai.

/proc + /dev

/proc — virtual filesystem, kernel ki window. /proc/cpuinfo CPU ki jaankari, /proc/meminfo memory, /proc/<pid> har process ki details. Files asli nahi hain — kernel on-the-fly banata hai.

/dev — devices: /dev/sda disk, /dev/null (kuch bhi daalo, gayab), /dev/random random numbers. echo hi > /dev/null — output gayab.

Sahi: cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep processor — CPU cores dekho.
Galat: /proc ki files ko edit karne ki koshish — wo read-only window hai.

  2. /etc ki config bina backup edit karna.

  5. Disk full hone par /var/log check na karna — logs hi sabse zyada bharte hain.

7. Interview corner

Q: Linux filesystem hierarchy samjhao.

/ se sab shuru hota hai. /home users ke liye, /etc config ke liye, /var/log logs ke liye, /bin aur /usr/bin commands ke liye, /tmp temporary ke liye, /proc kernel info (virtual) ke liye, /dev devices ke liye. Windows se farq: sab ek tree me hai, drive letters nahi hote.

Q: /proc kya hai?

Virtual filesystem — files asli nahi hain, kernel on-the-fly banata hai. /proc/cpuinfo se CPU, /proc/meminfo se memory, /proc/PID se har process ki details milti hain. Ye kernel ki window hai.

Q: Config files kahan hoti hain aur backup kyun zaroori hai?

/etc me. Edit se pehle .bak banao — ek galti se service start nahi hogi, aur wapas lana mushkil ho jayega. Version control me config rakhna aur bhi behtar hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Nginx ki config file kahan milegi?

  • /home/nginx
  • /etc/nginx/
  • /tmp/nginx

Sahi jawab: /etc/nginx/ — /etc me saari config files hoti hain — nginx ki bhi wahi hai.

Q2. CPU ki jaankari kahan se milegi?

  • /dev/cpu
  • /proc/cpuinfo
  • /var/cpu

Sahi jawab: /proc/cpuinfo — /proc virtual filesystem hai — kernel wahan CPU/memory ki jaankari deta hai.

Guide ke khaas points — Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (original se)

Linux file system pehle ek be-tarteeb sheher jaisa tha — har koi apna ghar jahan chahe bana leta tha. Phir 1994 me Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS) aaya, jisne Linux file system me order la diya.

FHS jaisa standard hone se software har Linux distribution par ek consistent layout ki ummeed kar sakta hai. Phir bhi har distribution FHS ko sakhti se follow nahi karta — kai apne unique elements jodte hain ya apni zaroorat ke hisaab se badalte hain.

FHS me expert banne ke liye explore karo: cd se navigate karo aur ls se directory ki listing dekho. File system ko ek ped (tree) samjho jo root (/) se shuru hota hai — waqt ke saath ye tumhari second nature ban jayega.

18DevTools and Productivity

Life is Short, Use Dev Tools

Life is short, use dev tools — developer ki zindagi chhoti hai, har kaam haath se mat karo. Ye page un dev tools ko samjhata hai jo roz ke kaam ko 10x tez karte hain: editor, terminal, Git, aur automation.

1. Life is Short, Use Dev Tools — aasan bhasha me

Dev tools aise hain jaise ek mistri ke auzaar: bina auzaar ke deewar banana ghanton ka kaam hai, sahi auzaar se minutes ka. Developer jo tools nahi use karta, wo har kaam haath se karta hai — aur zindagi chhoti hai, isiliye tools use karo. Editor, terminal, Git, snippets — ye sab tumhare auzaar hain.

Yaad rakhna: tool seekhne me jo 1 ghanta lagta hai, wo har hafte 5 ghante bachata hai. Tools par invest karo — ye compound interest ki tarah hai.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Editor

VS Code — aaj ka standard editor. Extensions se har language, har tool jud jata hai: ESLint, Prettier, GitLens, Copilot. Keyboard shortcuts seekh lo — mouse chhodo, haath keyboard par rahe.

Zaroori shortcuts: Ctrl+P (file kholo), Ctrl+Shift+P (command), Ctrl+D (same word select), Alt+click (multi-cursor). Multi-cursor se 10 jagah ek saath edit karo — ye ek feature hi ghante bachata hai.

Sahi: har hafte 2 naye shortcuts seekho — 1 mahine me speed double.
Galat: editor ko default settings par chalana — apne hisaab se configure karo.

Terminal

Terminal + shell — zsh + Oh My Zsh, ya fish. Autocomplete, history search (Ctrl+R), aliases — terminal ko apna banao. tmux se sessions save karo — SSH band ho to bhi kaam chalta rahe.

Aliases: alias gs='git status', alias ll='ls -la' — roz ke 100 commands 2 akshar ke ho jate hain. History search se purana lamba command 2 second me mil jata hai.

Sahi: .zshrc me aliases aur functions rakho — dotfiles Git me save karo.
Galat: har baar lamba command type karna — alias banao.

Git tools

GitLens, lazygit, GitHub CLI (gh) — Git ko aasan banao. GitLens VS Code me har line ka history dikhata hai — 'ye line kisne, kab, kyun likhi'. lazygit terminal me visual Git hai. gh pr create se terminal se hi PR banao.

Git aliases bhi banao: git config --global alias.st status — phir git st hi kaafi hai.

Sahi: GitLens se blame dekho — bug kis commit se aaya, 10 second me pata chalega.
Galat: git log ko bina --oneline --graph ke padhna — graph se history samajh aati hai.

Automation

Snippets, scripts, cron — jo kaam 3 baar se zyada karna ho, use automate karo. VS Code snippets se boilerplate ek shortcut me, shell scripts se deploy ek command me, cron se roz ke kaam schedule par.

Rule: 3 baar ka rule — pehli baar karo, dusri baar note karo, teesri baar automate karo. Automation me lagaya 1 ghanta har hafte bachata hai.

Sahi: deploy script likho — ./deploy.sh ek command, zero galti.
Galat: manual deploy har baar — ek din step bhoologe aur production girega.

Debugging

Debugger, logs, curl, jq — debugging ke auzaar. console.log se aage badho: breakpoints lagao, variables dekho, call stack padho. API debug ke liye curl + jq, logs ke liye tail -f + grep.

Browser DevTools bhi seekho: Network tab se API calls, Console se errors, Performance tab se slow code. Ye tools free hain aur har roz kaam aate hain.

Sahi: breakpoint lagana seekho — console.log se 10x tez debug hota hai.
Galat: sirf console.log se debug karna — bade bug me ghante lag jayenge.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Dev tools stack — ek table me

KaamToolKyun

Terminalzsh + tmux + aliasesSpeed, sessions
GitGitLens, lazygit, gh CLIHistory, PR terminal se

3 baar ka rule

1st time: karo — kaam ho gaya
2nd time: note karo — steps likh lo
3rd time: automate karo — script banao

Jo kaam 3 baar karna pade, wo 4th baar haath se mat karo.

4. Try karo — apna workflow tez karo

Ek roz ka kaam chuno — simulator batayega tool se kitna time bachega.

  1. File dhoondhni hai
  2. 10 jagah same edit
  3. Deploy karna hai
  4. Bug dhoondhna hai

KaamBina toolTool se

10 jagah edit5 min10 sec (multi-cursor)

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Tools seekhne me time 'waste' samajhna — wo investment hai.
  2. Har kaam mouse se karna — keyboard shortcuts seekho.
  3. Manual deploy har baar — automate karo.
  4. Sirf console.log se debug karna — debugger seekho.
  5. Dotfiles aur aliases ko save na karna — nayi machine par phir se setup.

7. Interview corner

Q: Developer productivity ke liye tumhare favourite tools kaunse hain?

VS Code + shortcuts (Ctrl+P, multi-cursor), zsh + aliases, GitLens, lazygit, debugger, aur automation scripts. Har tool ka ek example do — jaise multi-cursor se 10 jagah ek saath edit. Tools ka matlab hai repeat kaam khatam karna.

Q: 3 baar ka rule kya hai?

Jo kaam pehli baar karo, dusri baar steps note karo, teesri baar automate kar do. Manual repeat kaam galti aur time dono deta hai — script likhne me laga 1 ghanta har hafte bachata hai.

Q: Debugger console.log se behtar kyun hai?

Breakpoint par ruk kar variables, call stack aur state dekh sakte ho — bina code badle. console.log se har baar code badlo, chalao, dekho, hatao — slow aur ganda. Bade bugs me debugger 10x tez hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. 10 jagah same edit ek saath kaise karein?

  • Har jagah alag se
  • Multi-cursor (Ctrl+D)
  • Find-replace bina dekhe

Sahi jawab: Multi-cursor (Ctrl+D) — VS Code me Ctrl+D se same words select karke ek saath edit karo — seconds ka kaam.

Q2. Jo kaam 3 baar karna pade, uska kya karo?

  • Haath se karte raho
  • Automate karo (script banao)
  • Bhool jao

Sahi jawab: Automate karo (script banao) — 3 baar ka rule — teesri baar automate karo, manual repeat galti deta hai.

19DevTools and Productivity

How Git Works

Git kaam kaise karta hai — andar se? Snapshots, objects, branches, HEAD — ye sab samajh lo to Git ke har command ka matlab samajh aayega, aur kabhi kuch 'magically' nahi lagega. Ye page Git ke internals ko deep me kholta hai.

1. How Git Works — aasan bhasha me

Git aisa hai jaise ek photo album jisme har photo poora scene hai: har commit ek poori photo hai (snapshot), purani photo se farq nahi — poora scene. Branch ek sticky note hai jo photo par chipki hai ('ye latest hai'), aur HEAD wo sticky note hai jo batata hai tum abhi kaunsi photo dekh rahe ho. Photo kabhi delete nahi hoti — sirf nayi judti hai. Isiliye Git me kuch khoya nahi — sirf dhoondhna aana chahiye.

Core idea: Git snapshots store karta hai, diffs nahi. Har commit poore project ki photo hai — isiliye checkout tez hai aur history kabhi kharab nahi hoti.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Snapshots

Git har commit me poore project ka snapshot leta hai — har file ki copy. File badli nahi to purani copy ka link reuse hota hai (isiliye Git tez aur chhota hai). SVN jaise systems diff store karte hain, Git snapshot — farq samajh lo to Git samajh aayega.

Har cheez ka SHA-1 hash hota hai — content se banta hai. Content badla to hash badla. Isi se Git ko pata chalta hai kuch badla hai ya nahi, aur data corrupt hua to bhi pata chal jata hai.

Sahi: git cat-file -p HEAD — commit ke andar kya hai, khud dekho.
Galat: Git ko 'diff store karta hai' samajhna — snapshot model hi uski taakat hai.

Objects

Git ke andar 4 objects hote hain: blob (file ka content), tree (folder — kis file ka kaunsa blob), commit (snapshot + message + parent), aur tag (commit ka naam). Sab .git/objects me hash ke naam se rehte hain.

Commit apne parent ko point karta hai — isse history ek chain banti hai. git log isi chain ko peeche chal kar dikhata hai.

Sahi: git ls-files -s — staging me kya hai, blob level par dekho.
Galat: .git folder ko delete karna 'saaf' karne ke liye — poora history ud jayega.

Branches

Branch sirf ek pointer hai — ek file jisme commit ka hash likha hai (.git/refs/heads/main). Branch banana matlab ek chhoti file banana — isiliye Git me branch banana free hai, seconds ka kaam.

HEAD batata hai tum kis branch par ho — wo ek pointer hai jo branch ko point karta hai. git checkout HEAD ko badalta hai aur files ko us commit ke snapshot par le aata hai.

Sahi: branch ko pointer samajhna — merge aur rebase tabhi samajh aayenge.
Galat: branch ko folder ki copy samajhna — Git me kuch copy nahi hota.

Staging

Staging area (index) — agle commit ka draft. git add file ka snapshot index me daalta hai. git commit index se commit banata hai. git status working directory, index aur HEAD — teeno ka farq dikhata hai.

Isi liye ek file ka aadha hissa commit kar sakte ho (git add -p) — index me wahi jata hai jo tum chuno. Yehi Git ko powerful banata hai.

Sahi: git diff (working vs index) aur git diff --staged (index vs HEAD) — dono alag hain, dono dekho.
Galat: git commit -a har baar — staging ka fayda hi khatam.

Remote

Remote — dusri jagah ka repo (GitHub). git fetch remote ke objects lata hai aur origin/main jaise pointers update karta hai — tumhari local branches nahi chhooti. git pull = fetch + merge.

git push tumhare commits remote par bhejta hai. Remote sirf objects aur pointers ka exchange hai — Git distributed isiliye hai kyunki har copy poori hai.

Sahi: fetch karke pehle dekho kya aaya (git log origin/main), phir merge karo.
Galat: pull ko fetch samajhna — pull merge bhi karta hai.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Git ke andar — object chain

Commit (hash a1b2)
  ├── tree (root folder)
  │    ├── blob (app.js ka content)
  │    └── blob (README ka content)
  ├── parent (pichla commit)
  └── message ("fix: login")

Branch main → a1b2 (pointer)
HEAD → main (tum yahan ho)

.git/objects me sab hash ke naam se.
.git/refs/heads/ me branches (sirf hash likha hai).

Teen areas — phir se

AreaKya haiCommand
Working directoryTumhari filesedit karo
Staging (index)Agle commit ka draftgit add
RepositoryCommits ka historygit commit

4. Try karo — Git ke andar jhanko

Neeche commands chalao — simulator dikhayega Git ke andar objects aur pointers me kya hota hai.

  1. Commit banao — andar kya banta hai?
  2. Branch banao
  3. Checkout karo — HEAD kya karta hai?

5. Comparison — ek table me

ConceptKya hai
BlobFile ka content
TreeFolder ka snapshot
CommitSnapshot + parent + message
BranchCommit ka pointer
HEADTum kahan ho — pointer ka pointer
IndexAgle commit ka draft

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Git ko diff-based samajhna — wo snapshot-based hai.
  2. Branch ko copy samajhna — wo sirf pointer hai.
  3. .git folder delete karna — poora history khatam.
  4. git commit -a har baar — staging ka fayda khatam.
  5. Fetch aur pull ko ek samajhna — pull merge bhi karta hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: Git andar se kaise kaam karta hai?

Git snapshots store karta hai — har commit poore project ki photo hai (tree + blobs). Har object ka SHA-1 hash hota hai. Commit parent ko point karta hai — history chain banti hai. Branch sirf ek pointer hai (commit ke hash wali file), HEAD batata hai tum kis branch par ho. Staging area agle commit ka draft hai.

Q: Branch banana Git me itna sasta kyun hai?

Kyunki branch sirf ek chhoti file hai jisme commit ka hash likha hota hai — koi file copy nahi hoti. Isiliye branch banana seconds ka kaam hai, aur hazaron branches bhi repo ko bhaari nahi karti.

Q: Git me kuch delete ho jaye to wapas kaise late hain?

Commits kabhi turant delete nahi hote — reflog har move record karta hai (git reflog). Usse purana commit dhoondh kar checkout ya reset kar sakte ho. Garbage collection bahut baad me chalta hai — isiliye Git me 'khoya' data aksar wapas mil jata hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Git har commit me kya store karta hai?

  • Sirf badli hui lines (diff)
  • Poore project ka snapshot
  • Sirf commit message

Sahi jawab: Poore project ka snapshot — Git snapshot-based hai — har commit poori photo hai, diff nahi.

Q2. Branch asal me kya hai?

  • Files ki copy
  • Commit ka pointer (hash wali file)
  • Alag folder

Sahi jawab: Commit ka pointer (hash wali file) — Branch sirf ek pointer hai — isiliye banana free aur tez hai.

Guide ke khaas points — code chaar jagah rehta hai (original se)

Log samajhte hain ki code sirf do jagah rehta hai — ek remote server (jaise GitHub) par aur ek local machine par. Ye poori tarah sahi nahi hai. Git tumhari machine par teen local storages maintain karta hai, matlab code kul chaar jagah mil sakta hai:

  1. Working directory — jahan tum files edit karte ho.
  2. Staging area — temporary jagah jahan files agle commit ke liye rakhi jati hain.
  3. Local repository — commit ho chuka code yahan rehta hai.
  4. Remote repository — remote server jo code store karta hai.

Zyadatar Git commands files ko inhi chaar jagah ke beech move karte hain — ye samajh lo to har Git command ka matlab saaf ho jayega.

Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-does-git-work.md

20DevTools and Productivity

How do Companies Ship Code to Production?

Companies code ko production me kaise bhejti hain? Push karte hi kya hota hai — tests, review, staging, deploy, monitor? Ye page poori shipping pipeline ko deep me samjhata hai, startup se enterprise tak.

1. How do Companies Ship Code to Production? — aasan bhasha me

Code ship karna aisa hai jaise khana restaurant me serve karna: pehle recipe check hoti hai (code review), phir taste test hota hai (tests), phir ek plate pehle VIP ko di jati hai (canary), aur phir sabko serve hota hai (rollout). Bina taste kiye khana serve kar doge to ek kharab dish poore restaurant ki reputation kharab kar degi.

Yaad rakhna: shipping ka goal speed nahi, safe speed hai — tez bhi, aur kharab release ko 5 minute me wapas lene ki taakat bhi.

2. Deep dive — ek-ek point

Write & review

Kaam feature branch par hota hai, PR banta hai. Reviewer code dekhta hai — logic, edge cases, tests. CODEOWNERS se sahi log auto-assign hote hain. Bada PR review nahi hota — chhota PR, jaldi review.

Review me kya dekhte hain: kya code sahi hai, kya tests hain, kya security issue hai, kya docs chahiye. Reviewer 'LGTM' likhne se pehle khud code chalakar bhi dekh sakta hai.

Sahi: PR 200-400 lines — reviewer sach me padhega.
Galat: bina description ke PR — reviewer ko samajh hi nahi aata kya review kare.

CI — tests

PR bante hi CI (Continuous Integration) chalta hai: unit tests, lint, type check, build, security scan. Sab green ho tabhi merge. Ye gate automatic hai — koi 'jaldi hai, test skip karo' nahi.

Tests ke levels: unit (function), integration (services saath me), e2e (poora flow, browser se). Har level ka apna kaam — sirf unit tests se poora bharosa nahi milta.

Sahi: CI me test + lint + security scan — teeno green tabhi merge.
Galat: flaky tests ko ignore karna — ek din wo asli bug chhupa denge.

Build & staging

Merge hote hi build banta hai — Docker image ya bundle. Phir staging par deploy hota hai — production jaisa environment jahan QA hota hai. Staging par hi pata chalta hai ki code asli data aur asli infra par chalta hai ya nahi.

Build ek baar banta hai, har jagah wahi chalta hai (staging = production image). Alag-alag build karoge to 'staging par chal raha tha' wali galti hogi.

Sahi: ek build, har environment me wahi — image tag se version pehchano.
Galat: staging aur production ke liye alag build — farq kahin na kahin hoga.

Deploy

Deploy ke tareeke: rolling (ek-ek server badlo), blue-green (naya set tayyar, traffic switch karo), canary (pehle 5% users). Canary sabse safe hai — gadbad ho to turant wapas.

Feature flags se release aur rollout alag ho jate hain — code deploy karo, flag se dheere-dheere kholo. Database migrations pehle, code baad me — warna purana code naye schema par tootega.

Sahi: canary + flags — kharab release 5 minute me wapas.
Galat: Friday shaam ko big-bang deploy — weekend par koi fix karne wala nahi hoga.

Monitor

Deploy ke baad monitor karo: error rate, latency, business metrics (orders, signups). Alert tabhi jab user ko takleef ho. Dashboard par release ka naam likho — kaunsi release se error badha, ye dikhna chahiye.

Rollback plan pehle se tayyar rakho — ek command se purana version wapas. Rollback ki practice bhi karo, warna asli time par pata chalega rollback toota hua hai.

Sahi: deploy ke 30 minute tak dashboard khula rakho — pehle 30 minute me hi bug dikhta hai.
Galat: deploy karke bhool jana — error rate badh raha ho to bhi pata nahi chalega.

3. Aur gehra — tables aur code

Shipping pipeline — ek flow me

Branch → PR + Review → CI (test/lint/scan)
  → Merge → Build (Docker image)
  → Staging (QA) → Deploy (canary 5% → 50% → 100%)
  → Monitor (errors, latency) → Rollback (agar gadbad)

Database migration: code se PEHLE (backward compatible)
Feature flag: release aur rollout ko alag karo

Deploy strategies

StrategyKaiseRisk
RollingEk-ek server badloMedium
Blue-greenNaya set, traffic switchLow (instant rollback)
CanaryPehle 5% usersSabse low
Big-bangSab ek saathSabse high

4. Try karo — code ship karo, production tak

Steps ko order me chalao — galat order me chaloge to simulator batayega kya tootega.

  1. 1. PR + review
  2. 2. CI tests
  3. 3. Staging
  4. 4. Canary deploy
  5. 5. Monitor

5. Comparison — ek table me

StepKaun karta haiFail ho to?
ReviewTeammatePR wapas
CIAutomationMerge blocked
StagingQAFix karke dobara
CanaryDeploy systemAuto rollback
MonitorOn-callRollback / hotfix

6. Common galtiyan — ye mat karna

  1. Bina tests ke merge — production par bug 10x mehenga.
  2. Staging skip karke seedha production — pehla crash lakhon users par.
  3. Big-bang deploy — canary aur flags use karo.
  4. Database migration code ke saath — migration pehle, backward compatible.
  5. Deploy karke monitor na karna — error badh raha ho to pata hi nahi chalega.

7. Interview corner

Q: Code likhne se production tak ka safar samjhao.

Feature branch → PR + review → CI (tests, lint, security) → merge → build (Docker image) → staging (QA) → canary deploy (5% → 100%) → monitor (errors, latency) → rollback plan ready. Database migration code se pehle, backward compatible. Feature flags se rollout control karo.

Q: Canary aur blue-green me kya farq hai?

Canary me naya version pehle chhote % users ko milta hai, dheere-dheere badhta hai — risk sabse kam. Blue-green me poora naya environment tayyar karke traffic ek saath switch karte hain — rollback instant hai, par cost double (2 envs). Dono safe hain, canary zyada gradual hai.

Q: Database migration deploy se pehle kyun karte hain?

Kyunki purana code naye schema par toot sakta hai, par naya code purane schema par bhi chalna chahiye (backward compatible). Pehle migration (add column), phir code — phir purana column hatane ka migration. Isse zero-downtime deploy hota hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Deploy ka sabse safe tareeka kya hai?

  • Big-bang: sab ek saath
  • Canary: 5% → 50% → 100%
  • Seedha production, bina test

Sahi jawab: Canary: 5% → 50% → 100% — Canary se bug chhote group par dikhta hai aur rollback aasan hota hai.

Q2. Database migration kab karte hain?

  • Code deploy ke baad
  • Code deploy se pehle, backward compatible
  • Kabhi nahi

Sahi jawab: Code deploy se pehle, backward compatible — Migration pehle — naya code purane schema par bhi chale, phir purana column hatayo.

Guide ke khaas points — 10-step workflow (original se)

Guide ka diagram typical workflow dikhata hai — step by step:

  1. Step 1: Product owner requirements ke basis par user stories banata hai.
  2. Step 2: Dev team backlog se user stories uthakar sprint me daalti hai — two-week dev cycle.
  3. Step 3: Developers source code commit karte hain code repository Git me.
  4. Step 4: Jenkins me build trigger hota hai. Source code ko unit tests, code coverage threshold aur SonarQube ke gates pass karne hote hain.
  5. Step 5: Build successful ho to build Artifactory me store hota hai, phir dev environment me deploy hota hai.
  6. Step 6: Kai dev teams alag-alag features par kaam kar rahi hoti hain — features ko independently test karna hai, isliye wo QA1 aur QA2 environments me deploy hote hain.
  7. Step 7: QA team naye QA environments uthakar QA testing, regression testing aur performance testing karti hai.
  8. Step 8: QA builds QA team ki verification pass kar lein to wo UAT environment me deploy hote hain.
  9. Step 9: UAT testing successful ho to builds release candidates ban jate hain aur schedule par production environment me deploy hote hain.
  10. Step 10: SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team production monitoring ki zimmedar hoti hai.
Source:https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-do-companies-ship-code-to-production.md

← PichhlaHow do Companies Ship Code to Production?Agla →Interview FAQs
22End Matter

Interview FAQs

12 FAQs — aaj ke era ke interviews me poochhe jaane wale sawaal, seedhe jawab ke saath. Sawaal par tap karo, jawab khulega.

01Git aur GitHub me kya farq hai?
Git ek version control system hai — ye tumhare code ki history, branches aur commits ko local machine par manage karta hai. GitHub ek hosting platform hai jahan Git repositories online rehte hain — wahan PR, code review, CI/CD aur collaboration hota hai. Matlab Git tool hai, GitHub us tool ke liye online ghar hai. Git ke bina GitHub nahi, par GitHub ke bina bhi Git local par poori tarah kaam karta hai.
02Git merge aur git rebase me kya farq hai, aur kab kya use karna chahiye?
Merge do branches ko jod kar ek merge commit banata hai — poori history dikhti hai, aur shared branches ke liye safe hai. Rebase tumhare commits ko dusri branch ke upar seedha laga deta hai — history clean aur linear hoti hai, par ye history rewrite karta hai. Rule: apni local/private branch par rebase karo, shared branch par hamesha merge karo. Feature branch ko main me lane ke liye merge common hai; branch ko latest main se update karne ke liye rebase (agar branch sirf tumhari hai).
03Ek achha Git workflow kaise hota hai — clone se merge tak?
Pehle git clone se repo lo, phir git checkout -b feature/xyz se alag branch banao. Chhote-chhote commits karo (git add + git commit -m), phir git push origin feature/xyz karke pull request banao. Review aur CI pass hone ke baad merge karo, phir local main ko update karke branch delete karo. Roz main se rebase karke branch fresh rakho taaki merge conflict kam ho.
04git fetch, git pull aur git clone me kya farq hai?
Clone poora repo pehli baar local machine par lata hai — history ke saath. Fetch remote ke latest changes local par lata hai par tumhari working files ko chhedta nahi — sirf remote-tracking branches update karta hai. Pull matlab fetch + merge — remote changes ko tumhari current branch me mila deta hai. Safe tareeka: pehle fetch karke dekho kya badla, phir pull ya rebase karo.
05Linux me file permissions rwx aur chmod 755 ka kya matlab hai?
Har file par teen groups ke permissions hote hain — owner, group, others — aur har group ke liye read (r=4), write (w=2), execute (x=1). chmod 755 ka matlab owner ko 7 (4+2+1 = sab kuch), group ko 5 (4+1 = read+execute), others ko 5. Files ke liye 644 aur folders/scripts ke liye 755 sabse common hai. 777 kabhi mat do — isse sabko sab kuch mil jata hai, security ka bada risk hai.
06Linux file system me /etc, /var, /home, /usr aur /tmp kis kaam ke hain?
/etc me configuration files hoti hain, /var me logs aur badalta hua data (jaise /var/log), /home me har user ka personal data, /usr me installed programs aur libraries, /tmp me temporary files jo reboot par saaf ho jati hain. /bin me basic commands, /boot me boot files, /dev me devices. Ye layout samajh lo to Linux par koi bhi file dhoondhna aur debug karna aasan ho jata hai.
07JSON kya hai aur APIs me ise itna kyun use karte hain?
JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) data bhejne ka halka-phulka text format hai — key-value pairs aur arrays se bana hota hai, jo insaan bhi padh sakta hai aur machine bhi aasani se parse kar sakti hai. APIs me JSON isliye standard hai kyunki ye language-independent hai, XML se chhota hota hai, aur har language me iske liye ready-made parser milta hai. JSON Crack jaise tools se bade JSON ko visual diagram me dekh kar samajhna aasan ho jata hai.
08CPU 100% ho jaye to pehle kya check karna chahiye?
Pehle top ya htop se dekho ki kaun sa process CPU kha raha hai. Ek process 100% par hai to infinite loop, busy-wait ya heavy computation ho sakta hai — stack trace lo. Traffic spike hai to load aur rate limiting dekho. Memory bhi badh rahi hai to GC pressure ya memory leak ho sakta hai. Har ghante ek hi time par spike aaye to scheduled job ya cron culprit hai. Disk I/O wait zyada hai to CPU idle dikhega par app slow hogi — tab slow queries ya disk check karo.
09Diagram as Code kya hai aur kaun se tools use hote hain?
Diagram as Code ka matlab diagrams ko mouse se khinchne ki bajay code se likhna — jaise Mermaid, PlantUML, D2 ya Structurizr. Fayda ye hai ki diagram version control me rehta hai, review ho sakta hai, aur code badle to diagram bhi code se update hota hai. Mermaid Markdown me hi chal jata hai, PlantUML UML diagrams ke liye best hai, D2 modern aur saaf diagrams banata hai. System design docs aur architecture ke liye ye tareeka aaj standard ban gaya hai.
10SEO ke basics kya hain — crawler, indexing aur ranking kaise kaam karte hain?
SEO ke teen steps hain: crawling — search engine ke bots tumhari site ke pages dhoondhte hain; indexing — pages ko samajh kar search engine ke database me store kiya jata hai; ranking — query aane par sabse relevant pages ko order me dikhaya jata hai. Achhi SEO ke liye saaf URLs, sahi title/meta tags, fast loading, mobile-friendly design aur quality content chahiye. Sitemap aur robots.txt se crawler ko guide karte hain.
11Companies code ko production me kaise ship karti hain — CI/CD kya hai?
Code pehle feature branch par likha jata hai, phir pull request se review hota hai. Merge hote hi CI (Continuous Integration) automatically tests chalata hai, aur CD (Continuous Deployment) tested code ko staging phir production me deploy karta hai. Is pipeline me linters, type checkers, security scans aur automated tests hote hain — taaki kharab code production tak pahunche hi nahi. Feature flags se naya feature dheere-dheere users tak roll out hota hai.
12Open source projects me contribute kaise shuru karein?
Pehle aisa project chuno jo tum khud use karte ho. Uska README aur CONTRIBUTING guide padho, phir good-first-issue label wale chhote issues dhoondho. Repo fork karo, branch banao, fix karo, tests chalao, aur pull request banao. Pehle PR me docs ya chhota bug fix best hota hai. Linux, Git, VS Code, Kubernetes jaise projects ne duniya badli hai — aur inme se har ek me beginners ke liye jagah hai.
